2609.01900v1.title: Scalar Field Model for Dark Matter Spikes Surrounding Sgr A$^*$ and M87$^*$
2609.01900v1.abstract: Theoretical models suggest that the adiabatic growth of a black hole immersed in dark matter can lead to the formation of high density regions of dark matter, known as ``spikes'', near the black hole event horizon. The density of these spikes is determined theoretically and observationally to be a power law of the form $\rho(r) \propto r^{-\gamma_\text{sp}}$. It has been shown that the spike can potentially have a detectable impact on the emitted gravitational waves and shadow radius of the central black hole. In this work, we model the dark matter spike using a real scalar field with a non-standard potential. More specifically we ``reverse engineer'' the equations of motion to find a potential for the scalar field that permits a solution to the equations of motion with desired energy density and reasonable background geometry. We show that the emerging geometry is testable. In addition, the fact that the solution is derived from a covariant action makes it possible to study gravitational perturbations of the black hole in the presence of a spike including the backreaction of the spike.

classification.title_zh: 围绕人马座A*和M87*的暗物质尖峰的标量场模型
classification.abstract_zh: 理论模型表明，黑洞浸没在暗物质中时的绝热增长可以导致黑洞事件视界附近形成高密度暗物质区域，称为“尖峰”。这些尖峰的密度理论上和观测上均表现为ρ(r) ∝ r^{-γ_sp} 的幂律形式。已有研究表明，这种尖峰可能对中心黑洞发射的引力波和阴影半径产生可探测的影响。在这项工作中，我们使用具有非标准势能的实标量场对暗物质尖峰进行建模。更具体地说，我们对运动方程进行“逆向工程”，以找到一个标量场势，使得运动方程的解具有所需的能量密度和合理的背景几何。我们表明，由此产生的几何是可检验的。此外，由于该解来自协变作用量，因此可以研究存在尖峰时黑洞的引力扰动，包括尖峰的反作用。
classification.one_liner: 用实标量场模型重建黑洞周围暗物质尖峰的密度分布，并研究其对引力波和黑洞阴影的可观测影响。

2609.02311v1.title: Boundary-Geometry-Driven Black Hole Formation in Vacuum
2609.02311v1.abstract: We identify a boundary-geometry-driven mechanism for the dynamical formation of marginally outer trapped surfaces (MOTSs) in vacuum general relativity. Mild three-dimensional anisotropies evolve inside a compact Cauchy domain whose effective isotropic thickness remains controlled, while the generalized boundary mean curvature can increase during either contracting or expanding boundary evolution. This drives the boundary across Yau's geometric threshold, forcing MOTS formation from initially untrapped data. We further interpret the characteristic shear construction of Ref.~\cite{MondalYau2026} as the null manifestation of the same anisotropic vacuum dynamics. The result provides a purely vacuum physical realization of MOTS formation through global geometric effects, without invoking a short-pulse concentration mechanism for gravitational radiation.

classification.title_zh: 真空中的边界几何驱动黑洞形成
classification.abstract_zh: 我们确定了真空广义相对论中由边界几何驱动的动力学形成外部视界（MOTS）的机制。温和的三维各向异性在有效各向同性厚度受控的紧致柯西域内演化，而广义边界平均曲率可以在边界收缩或膨胀演化过程中增加。这驱动边界跨越 Yau 几何阈值，迫使最初未陷阱数据形成 MOTS。我们进一步将参考文献[MondalYau2026]的特征剪切构造解释为相同各向异性真空动力学的零测地线表现。该结果通过全局几何效应提供了 MOTS 形成的纯真空物理实现，而不需要借助短脉冲集中机制产生引力辐射。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种新的真空广义相对论机制：边界几何演化驱动 MOTS 形成，无需短脉冲集中。

2609.02313v1.title: Redshift Spectroscopy as a Probe of Regular Black Holes, Black Bounces, and Scalar-Hair Compact Objects
2609.02313v1.abstract: Motivated by [Phys. Rev. D. 107, 064019 (2023)], we develop a unified and model-independent framework for the spectroscopy of photon frequency shifts in generic static, spherically symmetric spacetimes. Working with a line element characterized by three arbitrary radial metric functions, we derive exact expressions for the conserved quantities of massive and massless probes, the conditions for circular timelike geodesics, the local-emission-angle-dependent photon impact parameter, and the corresponding local redshift and blueshift branches measured by distant static observers. The formalism is further extended to include the line-of-sight peculiar motion of the source and the local propagation of photons in a nonmagnetized cold plasma, thereby identifying the gravitational, orbital, and dispersive factors entering the frequency-shift signal under the stated assumptions. We also show that, in vacuum, the same geometric structures governing orbital spectroscopy determine the photon sphere and the shadow impact parameter whenever an external null critical orbit is present. To make the framework suitable for deformed compact-object models, we construct a perturbative expansion around Schwarzschild geometry up to second order in a dimensionless deformation parameter, obtaining explicit corrections to the orbital energy, angular momentum, emitter four-velocity, photon impact parameter, and the vacuum and plasma frequency shifts. We apply the formalism to regular black holes from nonlinear electrodynamics, the Simpson--Visser black-bounce spacetime, and the Fisher--Janis--Newman--Winicour--Wyman geometry. These examples show that the same local spectroscopic language can be used across regular-black-hole, black-bounce, wormhole, and scalar-supported horizonless sectors.

classification.title_zh: 红移光谱作为正则黑洞、黑弹跳和标量毛致密天体的探针
classification.abstract_zh: 受[Phys. Rev. D. 107, 064019 (2023)]启发，我们发展了一个统一且模型无关的框架，用于一般静态球对称时空中光子频率移的光谱学。利用由三个任意径向度规函数描述的线元，我们导出了有质量和无质量探针的守恒量、圆类时测地线的条件、依赖局部发射角的光子碰撞参数，以及远处静态观测者测量的相应局部红移和蓝移分支的精确表达式。该形式进一步扩展到包括源的视线方向本动运动以及光子在一非磁化冷等离子体中的局部传播，从而在所述假设下识别出进入频率移动信号的重力、轨道和色散因子。我们还表明，在真空中，控制轨道光谱学的同一几何结构决定了光子球和阴影碰撞参数（当存在外部零临界轨道时）。为了使框架适用于变形的致密天体模型，我们构建了围绕Schwarzschild几何的无量纲变形参数二阶微扰展开，得到了轨道能量、角动量、发射者四速度、光子碰撞参数以及真空和等离子体频率移动的显式修正。我们将该形式应用于来自非线性电动力学的正则黑洞、Simpson--Visser黑洞弹跳时空以及Fisher--Janis--Newman--Winicour--Wyman几何。这些例子表明，相同的局部光谱语言可以在正则黑洞、黑弹跳、虫洞和标量支持的无声视界区域中使用。
classification.one_liner: 发展了一个模型无关的静态球对称时空光子频率红移光谱学框架，并将其应用于正则黑洞、黑弹跳和标量毛致密天体。

2609.02456v1.title: Horizon energy fluctuations beyond Einstein's gravity: Gauss-Bonnet, Lovelock and Quantum deformed frameworks
2609.02456v1.abstract: We study thermal energy fluctuations of cosmological horizons within the canonical ensemble framework, treating the horizon as a thermodynamic system characterized by temperature and entropy. The analysis is performed for a class of gravitational theories, including (n+1)-dimensional Einstein gravity, Gauss-Bonnet gravity, Lovelock gravity, and models incorporating quantum deformed entropy corrections. We find that horizon energy fluctuations stabilize to a constant value in the asymptotic de Sitter limit, independent of the underlying gravity theory and robust against higher-curvature and quantum corrections. It is worth mentioning that in its final de Sitter state, the universe obeys holographic equipartition condition and in consequence the horizon entropy attains a maximum constant value, just like an ordinary macroscopic system. These findings establish a unified thermodynamic picture in which entropy maximization, holographic equipartition, and the suppression of energy fluctuations collectively characterize the asymptotic de Sitter universe as the equilibrium end state of cosmic evolution.

classification.title_zh: 超越爱因斯坦引力的视界能量涨落：Gauss-Bonnet、Lovelock 与量子变形框架
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在正则系综框架下研究宇宙学视界的热能量涨落，将视界视为具有温度和熵的热力学系统。分析针对一类引力理论展开，包括 (n+1) 维爱因斯坦引力、Gauss-Bonnet 引力、Lovelock 引力以及包含量子变形熵修正的模型。研究发现，在渐近 de Sitter 极限下，视界能量涨落稳定为一个常数，该常数不依赖于底层引力理论，并且对高曲率与量子修正具有鲁棒性。值得注意的是，在最终的 de Sitter 状态下，宇宙满足全息对分条件，因此视界熵达到最大常数值，正如普通宏观系统一样。这些发现建立了一个统一的热力学图景：熵最大化、全息对分与能量涨落的抑制共同将渐近 de Sitter 宇宙刻画为宇宙演化的平衡终态。

2609.02655v1.title: Relativistic stellar collapse of initially static configurations
2609.02655v1.abstract: We study the dynamics of a radiating relativistic star in the presence of the electromagnetic field and the cosmological constant. The evolution of the model originates from an initially static configuration. The temporal behaviour of the system is governed by a nonlinear second order equation which is studied using a phase plane analysis. We show that in the general case, with all physical parameters present, fold bifurcations arise which are related to nonzero charge and cosmological constant. Our treatment clarifies earlier results and we extend our study to the general solution space. We obtain a more comprehensive understanding of the temporal evolution for a shear-free configuration during collapse.

classification.title_zh: 初始静态构型的相对论性恒星坍缩
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在存在电磁场和宇宙学常数的情况下，一个辐射相对论性恒星的动力学。该模型的演化起源于一个初始静态的构型。系统的时间行为由一个非线性二阶方程控制，我们使用相平面分析进行了研究。我们表明，在所有物理参数都存在的一般情况下，会出现与非零电荷和宇宙学常数相关的折叠分岔。我们的处理澄清了早期结果，并将我们的研究扩展到一般的解空间。我们对剪切自由构型在坍缩过程中的时间演化获得了更全面的理解。

2609.02678v1.title: Ultralight Bosons Explain the Mass-Spin Correlations in the Merging Binary Black Hole Population
2609.02678v1.abstract: Ultralight bosons could trigger superradiant instabilities in rapidly spinning black holes, forming oscillating clouds while extracting rotational energy. We consider an extended, superradiance-informed spin distribution model that characterizes possible environment-induced spin variations and compare its predictions with the observed population of merging black hole binaries in the Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalogs (GWTCs). We find that the mass-spin relation predicted by a scalar boson with mass $m_b\sim 10^{-12} \,\rm eV$ is consistent with the GWTCs, with increasing significance from GWTC-3.0 to 5.0. The Bayes factor reaches $\ln B \approx 7.8$ for GWTC-5.0. Intriguingly, this mass range largely coincides with a previous study based on a waveform analysis of the GW190728 gravitational wave event. Our findings provide compelling evidence that a superradiance-informed spin distribution model is highly compatible with the expanding binary black hole population dataset.

classification.title_zh: 极轻玻色子解释并合双黑洞群体中的质量-自旋关联
classification.abstract_zh: 极轻玻色子可能触发快速旋转黑洞的超辐射不稳定性，在提取转动能的同时形成振荡云。我们考虑一种扩展的、基于超辐射的自旋分布模型，该模型表征可能的环境诱导自旋变化，并将其预测与引力波瞬变目录（GWTCs）中观测到的并合双黑洞群体进行比较。我们发现质量为$m_b\sim 10^{-12}\,\rm eV$的标量玻色子所预言的质量-自旋关系与GWTCs一致，且显著性从GWTC-3.0到5.0不断增加。对于GWTC-5.0，贝叶斯因子达到$\ln B \approx 7.8$。有趣的是，这一质量范围与先前基于GW190728引力波事件波形分析的研究大致重合。我们的发现提供了令人信服的证据，表明基于超辐射的自旋分布模型与不断扩大的双黑洞群体数据集高度兼容。
classification.one_liner: 极轻标量玻色子通过超辐射影响黑洞自旋分布，其质量-自旋关系与引力波目录中的双黑洞群体高度一致。

2609.02825v1.title: Charged black-hole binary radiation at second post-Newtonian order
2609.02825v1.abstract: In this work, we build on Ref.~[Phys.~Rev.~D 112, 124060 (2025)], where we derived the dynamics of an electrically charged binary system at second post-Newtonian (2PN) order, by extending the analysis, at the same PN accuracy, to the associated emission of electromagnetic and gravitational radiation. We focus on non-spinning binaries that evolve quasi-adiabatically along a sequence of circular orbits, and compute the 2PN expression for the corresponding total energy flux at infinity. With respect to the well-known case of a neutral binary, the presence of charge induces both a new leading-order electromagnetic contribution of dipolar nature and additional charge-dependent corrections in the gravitational sector. To account for this richer phenomenology, we extend both the PN-matched multipolar post-Minkowskian and the effective field theory approaches to the radiation sector of charged binaries, with exact agreement for the contributions computed independently in both formalisms. We derive the radiative symmetric-trace-free multipole moments of the vector and gravitational fields at 2PN order. In doing so, we also compute 2PN-accurate charge-dependent corrections to the spherical multipoles of the waveform emitted by the binary, including a new memory contribution sourced by the stress-energy tensor of the electromagnetic radiation. These results lay the foundation for developing accurate waveform models capable of assessing the observational signatures of electric charge in gravitational-wave signals.

classification.title_zh: 带电黑洞双星在二阶后牛顿阶的辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 本工作基于先前推导的带电双星系统二阶后牛顿(2PN)动力学，将分析扩展到相同PN精度下的电磁和引力辐射。研究非自旋双星沿圆轨道准绝热演化，计算无穷远处总能量通量的2PN表达式。电荷的存在引入了新的领先阶偶极电磁贡献和引力扇区中的电荷相关修正。作者扩展了PN匹配的多极后闵可夫斯基方法和有效场论方法，两种形式独立计算的贡献精确一致，并导出了矢量场和引力场在2PN阶的辐射对称无迹多极矩。还计算了2PN精度下波形球谐多极矩的电荷相关修正，包括由电磁辐射应力-能量张量产生的新记忆贡献。这为建立能评估引力波信号中电荷观测特征的精确波形模型奠定基础。
classification.one_liner: 计算带电黑洞双星在二阶后牛顿阶的电磁与引力辐射及波形修正，并包含记忆效应。

2609.00613v1.title: Nanohertz Gravitational-Wave Constraints on Supermassive Binary Black Holes at Cosmic Dawn
2609.00613v1.abstract: Standard continuous gravitational-wave searches with pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) neglect cosmological redshift, restricting their applicability to the local Universe. We introduce a redshift-aware PTA framework and apply it to the Parkes PTA Data Release 3, deriving the first direct constraints on supermassive binary black holes (SMBBHs) at the cosmic dawn. Evaluating our limits across a broad redshift range, we observationally establish the non-monotonic mass-redshift exclusion boundary driven by the theoretical ``redshift bias", demonstrating how PTAs can effectively probe sources at extreme distances. Redshift-aware targeted searches toward high-redshift systems, including the ultraluminous quasar J0100+2802 ($z=6.327$) and the JWST-discovered galaxy JADES-GS-z14-0 ($z=14.32$), rigorously exclude SMBBHs with chirp masses $\mathcal{M}_c \gtrsim 10^{10} M_\odot$ across the nanohertz frequency band. Finally, we demonstrate that high-redshift binaries can be robustly detected and localized, allowing for the accurate measurement of their intrinsic properties. Our results provide the tightest constraints to date on SMBBHs at $z > 6$ and establish a practical framework for probing early-Universe black hole assembly.

classification.title_zh: 纳赫兹引力波对宇宙黎明时期超大质量双黑洞的约束
classification.abstract_zh: 标准脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）连续引力波搜索忽略宇宙学红移，限制了其对本地宇宙的适用性。我们引入红移感知的PTA框架，并应用于Parkes PTA Data Release 3，首次直接约束宇宙黎明时期的超大质量双黑洞（SMBBHs）。在广泛红移范围内评估极限，我们观测上确定了由理论“红移偏差”驱动的非单调质量-红移排除边界，展示了PTA如何有效探测极远距离源。针对高红移系统（包括超亮类星体J0100+2802（z=6.327）和JWST发现的星系JADES-GS-z14-0（z=14.32））的红移感知定向搜索，严格排除了在纳赫兹频段内啁啾质量M_c ≳ 10^10 M_sun的SMBBHs。最后，我们证明高红移双星可被可靠探测与定位，从而准确测量其内在性质。我们的结果提供了迄今对z>6 SMBBHs的最强约束，并建立了探测早期宇宙黑洞形成的实用框架。
classification.one_liner: 利用红移感知的脉冲星计时阵列框架，首次直接约束宇宙黎明时期的超大质量双黑洞，排除高啁啾质量源。

2609.02867v1.title: Magnetized accretion onto rapidly spinning binary black holes: mini-disk thermodynamics, magnetic transport, and dual jets
2609.02867v1.abstract: Supermassive binary black holes embedded in gas-rich environments are promising multi-messenger sources for pulsar timing arrays and future space-borne gravitational-wave interferometers. Their electromagnetic emission is governed by nonlinear plasma dynamics around the binary and is expected to inherit variability associated with the orbital motion thereof. Because active galactic nuclei are intrinsically stochastic, identifying robust binary signatures requires predictive models that connect large-scale circumbinary flows to the black holes. Previous relativistic simulations of accreting binaries have mostly focused on smaller separations and lower spins. We perform three-dimensional general relativistic magnetohydrodynamic simulations of a relaxed, magnetized circumbinary disk accreting onto an equal-mass binary black hole with a separation of $30$ gravitational radii and dimensionless spin $\chi=0.9$. At these separations, the mini-disks around each black hole are persistent mass reservoirs but still show pronounced amplitude modulations governed by the eccentric circumbinary disk and the sloshing gas between the mini-disks. We analyze how the magnetic flux is transported from the circumbinary disk to the horizons, launching powerful dual jets with energy extraction efficiencies reaching $\approx 40\%$. The horizon-threading flux and jet luminosity alternate between the two black holes, producing an on-off dual-jet state. The wide jet funnels interact above the binary and form a persistent current sheet favorable to reconnection. We explore the influence of mini-disk thermodynamics, comparing efficient and inefficient cooling inside the cavity. Hotter mini-disks are less massive, exhibit weaker coherent periodicity, and launch less luminous jets despite comparable horizon-threading magnetic flux.

classification.title_zh: 磁化吸积到快速旋转的二进制黑洞：小盘热力学、磁输运和双喷流
classification.abstract_zh: 嵌入在富气体环境中的超大质量双黑洞是脉冲星计时阵列和未来天基引力波干涉仪的有前景的多信使源。其电磁辐射由双星周围的非线性等离子体动力学控制，预期带有轨道运动的变率。由于活动星系核本质上是随机性的，识别可靠的双星特征需要将大规模环双星流动与黑洞连接起来的预测模型。以往对吸积双星的相对论模拟大多集中在较小间距和较低自旋。我们对一个弛豫的磁化环双星盘吸积到等质量双黑洞进行了三维广义相对论磁流体动力学模拟，该双黑洞的间距为30个引力半径，无量纲自旋χ=0.9。在这些间距下，每个黑洞周围的小盘是持久的物质储库，但仍表现出显著的振幅调制，受偏心环双星盘和小盘之间晃动气体的控制。我们分析了磁通量如何从环双星盘输运到视界，从而发射能量提取效率达≈40%的强力双喷流。贯穿视界的磁通量和喷流光度在两个黑洞之间交替，产生一种开关式的双喷流态。宽阔的喷流漏斗在双星上方相互作用并形成有利于磁重联的持久电流片。我们探索了小盘热力学的影响，比较了腔内的有效冷却和低效冷却。较热的小盘质量较小，相干周期性较弱，并且尽管贯穿视界的磁通量相当，发射的喷流光度较低。
classification.one_liner: 对分离30引力半径、自旋0.9的双黑洞进行GRMHD模拟，发现持久小盘、磁通输运与交替开关的双喷流。

2603.04792v2.title: Search for continuous gravitational waves from neutron stars in five globular clusters in the first part of the fourth LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing run
2603.04792v2.abstract: We present the results of directed searches for continuous gravitational waves from unknown neutron stars in five Milky Way globular clusters. We carry out these searches in the LIGO data from the first eight months of the fourth LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing run using the WEAVE semicoherent program, which sums matched-filter detection-statistic values over many time segments spanning the observation period. No gravitational wave signal is detected in the search band of 20-475 Hz. Injections of simulated continuous wave signals in the data indicate that we achieve the most sensitive results to date across most of the explored parameter space volume, obtaining median 95% confidence level upper limits as low as $\sim 4.2 \times 10^{-26}$ near 282 Hz for NGC 6397. We also derive upper limits on neutron star ellipticity and $r$-mode amplitudes, reaching $\lesssim 10^{-5}$ and $\lesssim 10^{-3}$, respectively, at frequencies above 200 Hz.

classification.title_zh: 第四次LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA观测运行初期对五个球状星团中中子星连续引力波的搜寻
classification.abstract_zh: 我们展示了在银河系五个球状星团中搜寻未知中子星连续引力波的结果。我们使用WEAVE半相干程序，在第四LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA观测运行前八个月的LIGO数据中进行了这些搜寻；该程序在跨越观测期的多个时间段上累加匹配滤波检测统计量。在20-475 Hz的搜寻频带内未探测到引力波信号。向数据中注入模拟连续波信号表明，我们在所探索参数空间体积的大部分区域取得了迄今最灵敏的结果，对NGC 6397在约282 Hz处获得中位95%置信度上限低至约4.2×10^-26。我们还推导了中子星椭球度和r模振幅的上限，在200 Hz以上分别达到≲10^-5和≲10^-3。
classification.one_liner: 在四个球状星团中未发现连续引力波信号，但给出了迄今最灵敏的中子星椭球度和r模振幅上限。

2605.05362v4.title: Constraining Lorentz symmetry breaking in bumblebee gravity with extreme mass-ratio inspirals
2605.05362v4.abstract: Extreme mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs), with their long-lived and highly relativistic orbital evolution, can probe strong-field spacetime geometry and provide an important means to test general relativity. In this work, we investigate EMRI waveforms in a Schwarzschild-like black hole spacetime arising in bumblebee gravity, where Lorentz symmetry breaking (LSB) is characterized by a dimensionless parameter $\ell$. We construct EMRI waveforms within the Augmented Analytic Kludge (AAK) framework using the modified orbital frequencies and fluxes. We find that $\ell$ significantly affects the orbital evolution and thereby modifies the waveform. These modifications grow with increasing $\ell$ and are further enhanced for more eccentric orbits. Furthermore, using Bayesian analysis, we obtain the posterior distributions of EMRI with the parameter $\ell$ included. Our results show that all injected source parameters are recovered within their $1\,\sigma$ credible intervals. We find that the bumblebee parameter $\ell$ can be constrained with an uncertainty of order $\mathcal{O}(10^{-4})$ by LISA.

classification.title_zh: 利用极端质量比旋进约束大黄蜂引力中的洛伦兹对称性破缺
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋进（EMRIs）以其长寿命且高度相对论性的轨道演化，能够探测强场时空几何，并为检验广义相对论提供重要手段。本文研究在大黄蜂（bumblebee）引力中出现的类史瓦西黑洞时空中的EMRI波形，其中洛伦兹对称性破缺（LSB）由无量纲参数 ℓ 表征。我们在增强解析Kludge（AAK）框架内，利用修正后的轨道频率和通量构造EMRI波形。我们发现 ℓ 显著影响轨道演化，从而改变波形；这些修正随 ℓ 增大而增大，并在更偏心的轨道上进一步增强。此外，利用贝叶斯分析，我们得到包含参数 ℓ 的EMRI后验分布。结果表明所有注入源参数均可在 1σ 置信区间内恢复。我们发现通过LISA可将大黄蜂参数 ℓ 限制到约 O(10⁻⁴) 的不确定度。
classification.one_liner: 利用EMRI波形和贝叶斯分析，指出LISA可将大黄蜂引力中的洛伦兹破缺参数约束到约10⁻⁴量级。

2505.02821v2.title: High-Frequency Gravitational Wave Search with ABRACADABRA-10\,cm
2505.02821v2.abstract: High-frequency gravitational waves (HFGWs), above 10 kHz, promise a clean probe of new physics, largely free of the astrophysical backgrounds that complicate lower-frequency searches. Axion detectors, which search for axion dark matter via its coupling to electrodynamics in a strong magnetic field, should also be sensitive to HFGWs. We present the first dedicated search for HFGWs, using a modified ABRA-10cm axion detector, ABRA-GW, that runs simultaneously with a conventional axion search. ABRA-GW opens the 10 kHz-5 MHz band to HFGW searches and performs the first transient search by an axion experiment, targeting primordial black hole (PBH) mergers. Axion sensitivity is unaffected by the added gravitational-wave channel, and HFGW sensitivity matches theoretical expectations. This work demonstrates the broad physics reach of axion detectors and represents a first step toward a potential HFGW discovery.

classification.title_zh: 使用ABRACADABRA-10 cm搜索高频引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 高于10 kHz的高频引力波（HFGWs）有望成为新物理的清洁探针，基本不受低频搜索中复杂天体物理背景的影响。轴子探测器通过其在强磁场中与电动力学的耦合来搜索轴子暗物质，同时应对高频引力波敏感。我们展示了首次专门针对高频引力波的搜索，使用改进的ABRA-10cm轴子探测器ABRA-GW，与常规轴子搜索同时运行。ABRA-GW开辟了10 kHz-5 MHz频段的高频引力波搜索，并执行了轴子实验的首次瞬态搜索，目标为原初黑洞（PBH）并合。轴子灵敏度不受额外引力波通道的影响，高频引力波灵敏度与理论预期相符。这项工作展示了轴子探测器的广泛物理覆盖面，是迈向潜在高频引力波发现的第一步。
classification.one_liner: 利用改进的轴子探测器ABRA-GW首次开展10 kHz-5 MHz频段高频引力波搜索，并实现原初黑洞瞬态信号搜寻。

2602.11900v2.title: The total geodesic curvature and the $(2+1)$-dimensional hyperbolic mass
2602.11900v2.abstract: In this paper, we derive a novel geometric inequality involving the total geodesic curvature, serving as an analogue of the Brown-York mass in the setting of $(2+1)$-dimensional gravity. The asymptotic behaviour of this newly defined quasi-local mass is examined for large ellipses in the time-symmetric slices of the Ba\~{n}ados-Teitelboim-Zanelli black hole solutions. Moreover, we establish an improved upper bound for the $(2+1)$-dimensional hyperbolic Bartnik mass.

classification.title_zh: 总测地曲率与(2+1)维双曲质量
classification.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们推导了一个涉及总测地曲率的新型几何不等式，作为(2+1)维引力设定中 Brown-York 质量的类似物。我们研究了该新定义的拟局部质量在 Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli 黑洞解的类时对称切片中的大椭圆下的渐近行为。此外，我们还建立了(2+1)维双曲 Bartnik 质量的改进上界。
classification.one_liner: 推导了(2+1)维引力中基于总测地曲率的拟局部质量不等式，并给出其在 BTZ 大椭圆下的渐近行为及双曲 Bartnik 质量的改进上界。

2604.20971v2.title: Chaotic migration of LISA Extreme Mass Ratio Inspirals in a turbulent accretion disk: effect on waveform de-phasing
2604.20971v2.abstract: Gravitational wave (GW) detector LISA will observe near-coalescence extreme mass ratio inspirals (EMRIs), which typically form in galactic central accretion disks. Torques from the disk can alter the GW-driven inspiral trajectory of an embedded EMRI from the vacuum expectation, leading to potentially observable GW dephasing ($\Delta\psi_{\rm gas}$). So far, all studies compute $\Delta\psi_{\rm gas}$ for a thin, laminar disk, with negligible flow turbulence, whereby the disk exerts the well-understood linear torque ($T_{\rm lin}$). However, these disks must be turbulent due to magneto-rotational instability in the inner regions. Hence, we present a proof-of-concept general prescription for the turbulent torque ($T_{\rm turb}$) acting on an EMRI by modeling it as a Gaussian distribution around $T_{\rm lin}$, inspired by recent global simulations that study such torques. We compute $\Delta\psi_{\rm gas}$ for the ``golden'' circular EMRI with total source mass $M=10^6~{\rm M}_\odot$ and mass ratio $q=5\times10^{-5}$ in its final four-year evolution at redshift $z=0.276$ and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) $=50$ by varying turbulence amplitude $C$ ($=1$ in the aforementioned study), maximum correlation timescale ($N_{\rm max}$), Eddington ratio ${\rm f}_{\rm Edd}$, disk aspect ratio $h_0$, and turbo-viscous coefficient $\alpha$ in a reasonable parameters space. For $N_{\rm max}=100$ orbits, we find that for $C\gtrsim{10}$, ${\rm f}_{\rm Edd}\gtrsim0.3$, $h_0\gtrsim0.03$, and $\alpha\gtrsim0.1$, dephasings due to $T_{\rm lin}$ are unobservable but could become detectable ($\Delta\psi_{\rm gas}>8/$SNR) if EMRIs experience turbulent torques. Hence, this work motivates running MHD simulations of accretion disks with embedded early-inspiral LISA EMRIs over long timescales to understand the imprint of the turbulent environment on their orbital parameters and gravitational waveforms.

classification.title_zh: 湍流吸积盘中LISA极端质量比旋进的混沌迁移：对波形失谐的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波探测器LISA将观测近并合的极端质量比旋进（EMRI），这类系统通常形成于星系中心的吸积盘。盘的力矩会改变嵌入的EMRI受引力波驱动的旋进轨道，使其偏离真空期望，导致可能可观测的引力波失谐（Δψ_gas）。迄今所有研究均针对薄层流吸积盘计算Δψ_gas，其中湍流可忽略，盘施加已知的线性力矩T_lin。然而，由于内区磁转动不稳定性，这些盘必然存在湍流。因此，我们提出一个概念验证性的一般方案，将T_lin周围的湍流力矩T_turb建模为高斯分布，受近期全球模拟启发。我们计算‘黄金’圆轨道EMRI的Δψ_gas，其总源质量M=10^6 M_sun，质量比q=5×10^-5，红移z=0.276，信噪比SNR=50，在最终四年演化中改变湍流振幅C、最大相关时标N_max、爱丁顿比率f_Edd、盘厚高比h_0以及粘滞系数α。对于N_max=100轨道周期，我们发现当C≳10、f_Edd≳0.3、h_0≳0.03和α≳0.1时，T_lin产生的失谐不可观测，但若EMRI经历湍流力矩则可能变得可检测（Δψ_gas>8/SNR）。因此，这项工作激励进行长时间尺度的、包含早期旋入LISA EMRI的吸积盘MHD模拟，以理解湍流环境对其轨道参数和引力波波形的印记。
classification.one_liner: 研究表明吸积盘湍流力矩可能使LISA极端质量比旋进的引力波失谐变得可探测，需进一步MHD模拟。

2609.02441v1.title: Effects of Strong Magnetic Fields on the Equation of State and Mass-Radius Structure of Hyperonic Neutron-Star Matter with Anomalous Magnetic Moments
2609.02441v1.abstract: We investigate the effects of strong magnetic fields on the equation of state (EoS) and stellar structure of cold, charge-neutral, $\beta$-equilibrated hyperonic neutron-star matter within a relativistic mean-field (RMF) framework. The matter sector contains the full baryon octet and leptons, while charged particles are Landau quantized and all baryons are coupled to the magnetic field through their anomalous magnetic moments (AMM). The calculation is performed with the RMF FSU2H hyperonic parameterization and compared for zero field, constant magnetic fields, and density-dependent magnetic-field profiles. We find that strong magnetic fields modify the hyperonic composition through the competing effects of Landau quantization and AMM-induced spin splitting. Landau quantization softens the magnetized hyperonic equation of state. The inclusion of AMM provides an additional magnetic stiffening mechanism in hyperonic matter. The results for the inclusion of the AMM coupling and not are still consistent with observations of $2.00$-$2.02\,M_{\odot}$ neutron stars and small radii. The present work therefore provides a benchmark for assessing the influence of AMM on the composition, magnetization, equation of state, and mass-radius structure of magnetized hyperonic neutron-star matter.

classification.title_zh: 强磁场及反常磁矩对超子中子星物质状态方程和质量-半径结构的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在相对论平均场（RMF）框架下研究强磁场对冷、电荷中性、β平衡的超子中子星物质的状态方程（EoS）和恒星结构的影响。物质部分包含完整重子八重态和轻子，带电粒子被朗道量子化，所有重子通过其反常磁矩（AMM）与磁场耦合。计算采用RMF FSU2H超子参数化，并对零场、恒定磁场和密度相关磁场轮廓进行了比较。我们发现强磁场通过朗道量子化和AMM诱导的自旋劈裂的竞争效应改变超子组成。朗道量子化使磁化超子状态方程变软。AMM的加入为超子物质提供了额外的磁硬化机制。有无AMM耦合的结果都与2.00-2.02太阳质量中子星和小半径的观测相容。因此，当前工作为评估AMM对磁化超子中子星物质的组成、磁化、状态方程和质量-半径结构的影响提供了一个基准。
classification.one_liner: 通过相对论平均场模型研究强磁场下含超子中子星物质中朗道量子化与反常磁矩对状态方程和质量-半径关系的竞争效应。

2609.03023v1.title: Holographic zeros and poles from apparent singularities
2609.03023v1.abstract: We study general holographic fluctuation equations with apparent singularities, and the associated spectral functions. We consider the regime where an apparent singularity approaches the boundary, for which the near-boundary behavior of solutions can be determined via an inner/outer matching type of calculation. Depending on properties of the equation, we find that the merging of an apparent singularity with the boundary may generate either a zero or a pole for the corresponding spectral function. Our results also indicate that the recently introduced holographic product formula still applies in the presence of apparent singularities.

classification.title_zh: 视在奇点的全息零点与极点
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有视在奇点的一般全息涨落方程及其关联的谱函数。我们考虑视在奇点逼近边界的区域，在此区域可以通过内外匹配类型的计算确定解的近边界行为。根据方程的性质，我们发现视在奇点与边界的合并可能为相应的谱函数产生零点或极点。我们的结果还表明，最近引入的全息乘积公式在视在奇点存在的情况下仍然适用。
classification.one_liner: 研究视在奇点与边界合并如何导致全息谱函数的零点或极点，并验证全息乘积公式的适用性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦全息谱函数的视在奇点一般性分析，与用户具体研究支线无直接对应。

2609.03126v1.title: Boundary-Value Problem in Type IIB Supergravity and Holography
2609.03126v1.abstract: In precision holography, the Euclidean on-shell action of type IIB supergravity often fails to reproduce the leading large-$N$ free energy of the dual field theory: the type IIB pseudo action, for instance, vanishes identically on the $\mathrm{EAdS}_5\times S^5$ background. We address this issue by revisiting the boundary-value problem of the Euclidean type IIB pseudo action from first principles. Classifying the admissible boundary conditions through the variational principle, we construct a generalized pseudo action whose boundary terms implement the choice of ensemble --- fixed potentials versus fixed quantized Page charges --- in which the holographic comparison is performed. For the fixed five-form-charge ensemble, the resulting boundary term reproduces the recently proposed topological correction to the Pasti--Sorokin--Tonin formulation of type IIB supergravity for holographic backgrounds of interest. We then test the generalized pseudo action on two complementary backgrounds: the $\mathrm{EAdS}_3\times S^3\times M_4$ near-horizon geometry of the D1-D5 system and the warped $\mathrm{EAdS}_6\times S^2\times\Sigma$ solutions dual to five-dimensional SCFTs. In both cases the ten-dimensional on-shell action agrees exactly with that of the corresponding lower-dimensional supergravity, and thereby with the leading large-$N$ free energy of the dual SCFT. Our results establish the choice of boundary conditions --- and hence of ensemble --- as an essential ingredient of precision holography directly in type IIB supergravity, extending recent analyses in eleven-dimensional supergravity.

classification.title_zh: IIB型超引力的边值问题与全息
classification.abstract_zh: 在精密全息中，IIB型超引力的欧氏在壳作用量往往无法再现对偶场论的大N自由能领头阶：例如，IIB型赝作用量在 EAdS_5×S^5 背景上恒等于零。我们通过从第一性原理重新审视欧氏 IIB 型赝作用量的边值问题来解决这一困难。通过变分原理对可容许边界条件进行分类，我们构造了一个推广的赝作用量，其边界项体现了进行全息比较时所选取的系综——固定势还是固定量子化 Page 荷。对于固定五形式荷系综，所得的边界项重现了最近提出的 IIB 型超引力 Pasti-Sorokin-Tonin 表述的拓扑修正，适用于感兴趣的全息背景。随后我们在两个互补背景上检验了这个推广的赝作用量：D1-D5 系统的 EAdS_3×S^3×M_4 近邻几何，以及对偶于五维 SCFT 的弯曲 EAdS_6×S^2×Σ 解。在这两种情形下，十维在壳作用量都与相应的低维超引力作用量精确一致，从而与对偶 SCFT 的大 N 自由能领头阶一致。我们的结果确立了边界条件——因而系综——的选择是直接在 IIB 型超引力中进行精密全息的一个基本要素，扩展了最近在十一维超引力中的分析。
classification.one_liner: 通过构造推广的 IIB 型超引力赝作用量边界项，解决其在全息背景下在壳作用量为零的问题，并验证了与对偶大N自由能的一致性。
classification.relevance_reason: 与重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”相关，但其核心是精密全息字典与超引力边值问题，而非用户主要关注的凝聚态、探针膜或QNM支线。

2609.03347v1.title: Conical Defects in JT Gravity from BF Theory: Quantization, Fusion, and Weighted Moduli Spaces
2609.03347v1.abstract: We construct a gauge-invariant BF representative of a conical defect in Jackiw--Teitelboim gravity, with its elliptic direction fixed by the reconstruction of the gravitational variables. In the gravitational sector, the BF observable reproduces the metric defect insertion and its distributional curvature source, and fixes the holonomy around the defect to an elliptic conjugacy class. For a single defect on the disk, the position integral combines with the residual \(\mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb R)\) quotient, leaving a fixed elliptic sector. The exact boundary quantization of this sector gives the elementary kernel and one-defect disk amplitude directly, without using a matrix model. The same local BF operator describes both sharp and blunt defects. Their difference appears only when several defect positions are integrated. BF source composition makes the fractional deficits additive. Requiring a fused source to remain in the gravitational cone sector gives the admissibility condition for defect collisions, while positivity of the hyperbolic area on each component gives the corresponding stability condition. These conditions coincide with those for Hassett weighted curves. Combining these BF results with the known Hassett compactification and conical Weil--Petersson geometry yields the fixed-order genus-zero contact terms and recovers the cluster expansion of deformed JT gravity. Thus sharp and blunt defects differ through the compactified geometry of their relative positions, rather than through the elementary BF operator.

classification.title_zh: 来自BF理论的JT引力中的锥形缺陷：量子化、融合与加权模空间
classification.abstract_zh: 我们从BF理论出发，构造了Jackiw–Teitelboim（JT）引力中锥形缺陷的规范不变BF表示，并通过重构引力变量固定其椭圆方向。在引力扇区中，该BF可观测量重现了度规缺陷插入及其分布型曲率源，并使绕缺陷的holonomy固定为椭圆共轭类。对于圆盘上的单缺陷，位置积分与剩余的PSL(2,R)商空间结合，留下一个固定的椭圆扇区。该扇区的精确边界量子化直接给出基本kernel和单缺陷圆盘振幅，无需使用矩阵模型。同一个局部BF算子既描述尖锐缺陷也描述钝缺陷；它们的差别仅在多个缺陷位置被积分时显现。BF源的合成使分数亏缺具有可加性；要求熔合源仍处于引力锥扇区给出缺陷碰撞的可容许条件，而每个分量上双曲面积的正性给出相应的稳定性条件。这些条件与Hassett加权曲线一致。将上述BF结果与已知Hassett紧化及锥形Weil–Petersson几何结合，可得到固定阶亏格零接触项，并恢复deformed JT引力的cluster展开。因此，尖锐与钝缺陷通过其相对位置的紧化几何区分，而非通过基本BF算子。
classification.one_liner: 用BF理论构造JT引力锥形缺陷的规范不变表示，结合Hassett加权模空间解释尖锐与钝缺陷的差异，并恢复deformed JT引力的cluster展开。

2609.03007v1.title: Tidally-enhanced resonances in extreme-mass-ratio inspirals: A tertiary path to chaos
2609.03007v1.abstract: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) provide a unique laboratory for probing strong-field gravity and complex relativistic dynamics. We study a tidally deformed EMRI composed of a stellar-mass secondary orbiting a supermassive (non-)rotating black hole embedded in an external, adiabatically varying tidal environment. These systems provide a restricted, yet astrophysically motivated, realization of the relativistic three-body problem, expected to appear in active galactic nuclei, with a clear hierarchy of masses and radiation-reaction timescales. The external tidal deformation breaks the axisymmetry of the Kerr spacetime, rendering the geodesic dynamics non-integrable and giving rise to chaotic motion. The resulting signature of non-integrability is characterized through Poincar\'e maps and rotation curves constructed from the ratios of the fundamental frequencies of bound radial, polar, and azimuthal motion. We identify two prominent plateaus whose widths increase with the tidal field amplitude, signaling a transition from weak to strong chaos. We then demonstrate the sensitivity of the chaotic dynamics to the orientation of the orbit relative to the tidal field. We further analyze the proper-time evolution of the action-angle variables, showing that the angle combinations associated with the dominant commensurabilities are phase locked, thereby allowing the associated tidal contributions to induce secular changes in the constants of motion, whereas off-plateau angle combinations circulate. These results clarify the dynamical significance of the prominent plateaus and provide a novel phase-space characterization of tidal resonances in EMRIs. Finally, we discuss the potential role of radiation-reaction effects in driving EMRIs through tidal island crossings and the implications for gravitational-wave inference with future detectors.

classification.title_zh: 极端质量比旋进中的潮汐增强共振：通向混沌的三体路径
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋进（EMRIs）为探测强场引力和复杂相对论动力学提供了独特实验室。我们研究了一个潮汐形变的EMRI，由一个绕超大质量（非）旋转黑洞旋转的恒星质量次级体组成，该黑洞嵌入外部绝热变化的潮汐环境中。这些系统提供了相对论三体问题的一个受限但天体物理动机明确的实现，预期出现在活动星系核中，具有清晰的质量层级和辐射反作用时间尺度。外部潮汐形变破坏了Kerr时空的轴对称性，使测地线动力学不可积并产生混沌运动。通过庞加莱映射和由束缚径向、极向和方位运动基本频率之比构建的旋转曲线，刻画了不可积性的特征。我们识别出两个显著的平台，其宽度随潮汐场振幅增加，标志着从弱混沌到强混沌的转变。然后我们展示了混沌动力学对轨道相对潮汐场方向的敏感性。我们进一步分析了作用-角变量的固有时演化，表明与主导共振相关的角组合被相位锁定，从而使相关潮汐贡献能够引起运动常数的长期变化，而平台外的角组合则循环。这些结果阐明了显著平台的动力学意义，并为EMRIs中的潮汐共振提供了新的相空间表征。最后，我们讨论了辐射反作用效应在驱动EMRIs穿越潮汐岛区方面的潜在作用，以及对未来探测器引力波推断的影响。
classification.one_liner: 研究外部潮汐环境导致EMRI的Kerr测地线运动不可积并产生混沌，揭示了潮汐增强共振的平台结构及其对引力波推断的意义。

2609.03012v1.title: Universal CMB Phase Coherence from Single-Field Inflation
2609.03012v1.abstract: The phase coherence of primordial perturbations shapes the acoustic peaks of the CMB and is regarded as a key signature of inflation. Inflationary scenarios at different energy scales, thus with different durations, are commonly expected to leave different levels of coherence. We show this expectation fails: because the curvature perturbation is conserved on super-Hubble scales, the coherence at recombination inherits a value fixed by the observed primordial spectrum alone. This holds irrespective of the inflationary energy scale and the subsequent expansion history.

classification.title_zh: 单场暴胀中的普适CMB相位相干性
classification.abstract_zh: 原初扰动的相位相干性塑造了CMB的声学峰，并被视为暴胀的关键特征。通常认为，不同能标因而不同持续时间的暴胀情形会留下不同程度的相干性。我们证明这一预期并不成立：由于曲率扰动在超视界尺度上守恒，重组时期的相干性继承了一个仅由观测到的原初谱确定的数值。这一结论与暴胀能标及随后的膨胀历史无关。
classification.one_liner: 暴胀原初扰动的相位相干性在重组时期由观测到的原初谱单独固定，与暴胀能标和后续膨胀历史无关。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力宇宙学/暴胀理论，与经典引力支线相关，但不是全息或经典黑洞/引力波核心问题。

2609.03053v1.title: Multi-Boundary Many-Body Quantum Teleportation
2609.03053v1.abstract: Unlike standard quantum teleportation, many-body teleportation uses scrambling to transmit quantum information. In this protocol, initially localized information spreads over many degrees of freedom and is later refocused at the receiver by a simple coupling between the systems, followed by further many-body evolution. The protocol was developed from models of traversable wormholes in holography and has become a useful probe of scrambling. In particular, it can distinguish genuine scrambling from decoherence or noise when out-of-time-order correlators fail, and can reveal signatures of different scrambling mechanisms, including the distinctive behavior expected in holographic systems. Holography predicts that related protocols can transmit information between selected boundaries of multi-boundary wormhole geometries. Motivated by this setting, we study single-qubit many-body teleportation among three systems of qubits. The initial state consists of EPR pairs distributed among them, providing a simple analogue of an infinite-temperature three-boundary holographic state. We analyze the protocol with one-dimensional and all-to-all dynamics, both analytically and numerically using random circuits. We find that the third system suppresses teleportation once the spreading message reaches the region of qubits that are entangled with it. In one dimension, both the minimum coupling required for successful teleportation and the fidelity depend on the distance from the injection site to this region, a feature reminiscent of holographic causal shadows. For all-to-all dynamics, successful teleportation is instead restricted to early times and to sufficiently few qubits entangled with the third system. A third system therefore provides spatial, or subsystem, resolution of information spreading that is absent from the two-sided protocol. Our results offer a step toward many-body teleportation networks.

classification.title_zh: 多边界多体量子隐形传态
classification.abstract_zh: 与标准量子隐形传态不同，多体隐形传态利用量子扰乱来传输量子信息。在该协议中，初始局域化的信息扩展到许多自由度中，随后通过系统间简单的耦合以及进一步的多体演化在接收端重新聚焦。该协议源于全息中可穿越虫洞的模型，并且已成为探测量子扰乱的有力工具。特别是，当离时序关联函数失效时，它能区分真正的扰乱与退相干或噪声，并揭示不同扰乱机制的特征，包括全息系统中预期的独特行为。全息理论预言，相关协议可以在多边界虫洞几何的选定边界之间传输信息。受此情景启发，我们研究了三个量子比特系统之间的单量子比特多体隐形传态。初始态由分布在它们之间的EPR对组成，提供了无限温度三边界全息态的一个简单模拟。我们使用随机电路，通过解析和数值方法分析了一维与全对全动力学。我们发现，一旦传播的信息到达与第三系统纠缠的量子比特区域，第三个系统就会抑制隐形传态。在一维情形，成功隐形传态所需的最小耦合强度以及保真度都取决于注入点到该区域的距离，这一特征让人联想到全息因果阴影。在全对全动力学下，成功的隐形传态反而局限于早期时间，并且只限于与第三系统纠缠的量子比特数目足够少的场景。因此，第三个系统提供了双面协议所不具备的、对信息传播的空间或子系统分辨能力。我们的结果朝着多体隐形传态网络迈出了一步。
classification.one_liner: 该工作受多边界全息虫洞启发，研究了三系统量子比特网络中的多体隐形传态，并揭示了第三个系统如何对信息扰乱提供空间分辨的抑制效应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要关注多体量子隐形传态与扰乱探针，与用户重点标签中的全息凝聚态、相变、QNM、探针膜等方向无直接对应。

2609.03082v1.title: Gravitational Waves and Matter Constraints in Gravity from Entropy
2609.03082v1.abstract: We show that Gravity from Entropy (GfE) exhibits a tensor-propagation pathology on generic FLRW backgrounds. In vacuum, in the symmetry-inheriting single-multiplet sector, and for the algebraic perfect-fluid constitutive embedding, the strict-principal TT system has a nonzero real characteristic only when \(\dot H=K/a^2\). Away from this locus the temporal principal roots become complex, signaling a high-frequency hyperbolicity obstruction. Under the stated isotropy assumptions, a rank theorem further shows that one foundational multiplet cannot provide the isotropic bivector response needed to remove this problem.

classification.title_zh: 熵引力中的引力波与物质约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明熵引力（GfE）在一般FLRW背景上存在张量传播病态。在真空、继承对称的单多重态扇区以及代数完美流体本构嵌入下，严格主TT系统仅当 Ḣ=K/a² 时具有非零实特征；离开该轨迹后，时间主根变为复数，表明高频双曲性障碍。在上述各向同性假设下，秩定理进一步表明一个基础多重态无法提供消除该问题所需的各向同性双矢响应。
classification.one_liner: 熵引力在一般FLRW背景上的引力波张量传播存在高频双曲性障碍。
