2609.06374v1.title: Detectability of bulk viscosity effects on post-merger gravitational wave signals from binary neutron star mergers
2609.06374v1.abstract: We investigate bulk viscosity (BV) effects on post-merger gravitational wave (PMGW) signals from binary neutron star (BNS) mergers and their detectability using realistic equation of state (EoS) posteriors constrained by recent progress in gravitational-wave (GW) and X-ray observations, as well as neutron skin thickness measurements. A linear fitting formula based on recent BNS simulations with BV is used to estimate the peak frequency shift of the PMGWs caused by BV effects. Subsequently, we evaluate this peak frequency shift for our set of EoS posterior samples. We use the Fisher information matrix and the dataset of simulated observable events from the ET and CE detector network in an optimistic scenario to estimate the measurement accuracy of the peak frequency. We find that BV effects on PMGWs may be detectable only for EoS models with large values of the symmetry energy slope ($L_{\rm sym}$), as favored by neutron-skin thickness measurements. Thus, the detection of BV effects on PMGWs itself can provide abundant information about the symmetry energy and its slope. However, BV effects on PMGWs are generally weak and may be observed only in some extreme and optimistic cases. Therefore, observations of PMGWs and their analyses may not be able to provide very accurate measurements of the symmetry energy through BV effects.

classification.title_zh: 双中子星并合后引力波信号中体粘滞效应的可探测性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究体粘滞（BV）对双中子星（BNS）并合后引力波（PMGW）信号的影响，及其在利用由近期引力波（GW）和X射线观测以及中子皮厚度测量所约束的现实状态方程（EoS）后验样本下的可探测性。使用基于近期含BV的BNS模拟的线性拟合公式来估计由BV效应引起的PMGW峰值频率偏移。随后，我们针对EoS后验样本集合评估该峰值频率偏移。我们使用Fisher信息矩阵以及ET和CE探测器网络在乐观情景下的可观测事件模拟数据集，来估计峰值频率的测量精度。我们发现，BV对PMGW的影响可能仅在具有较大对称能斜率（$L_{\rm sym}$）的EoS模型中可探测，而这正是中子皮厚度测量所倾向的。因此，对PMGW的BV效应的探测本身可以提供关于对称能及其斜率的丰富信息。然而，BV对PMGW的影响通常较弱，可能仅在一些极端和乐观的情况下被观测到。因此，对PMGW的观测及其分析可能无法通过BV效应提供非常精确的对称能测量。
classification.one_liner: Bulk viscosity effects on post-merger gravitational waves from binary neutron star mergers are weak and only detectable in optimistic cases with large symmetry energy slope, limiting their use for precise symmetry energy constraints.
classification.relevance_reason: Studies classical gravitational wave signals from binary neutron star mergers and equation-of-state effects, matching the classical gravity/GR focus tag.

2609.07703v1.title: Bridging the Population Synthesis of Supermassive Binary Black Holes and the Gravitational Wave Background
2609.07703v1.abstract: Pulsar Timing Arrays (PTAs) constrain population properties of supermassive binary black holes (SMBHBs) through the observation of the gravitational wave background (GWB). Unlike other approaches that interpolate population-synthesis libraries or only consider the mean of the strain spectrum, here we capture its full strain probability density directly from semi-analytic population models. We apply our new method to the semi-analytic SMBHB population model, independently reproducing the parameter estimation for this model performed by the NANOGrav Collaboration with their 15-yr data. We also show the extent to which discrete SMBHB contributions to the GWB resolve degeneracies in the population parameter space. Finally, using the source-count intensity as the intermediate product in our calculation, we map PTA observations, as a proof of principle, to the SMBHB model based on the galaxy merger prescriptions from numerical hydrodynamical simulations "Illustris". We find the effect of delay times $\tau$ between kiloparsec and subparsec SMBHB separations following galaxy mergers, finding $h_{\rm c}$ spanning $(1$-$6)\times10^{-16}$ and $N_{\rm c}$ spanning $(0.3$-$7.1)\times10^{-3}$ for $\tau$ up to 8 Gyr.

classification.title_zh: 桥接超大质量双黑洞的族群合成与引力波背景
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列(PTA)通过观测引力波背景(GWB)约束超大质量双黑洞(SMBHB)的族群性质。与内插族群合成库或仅考虑应变谱均值的方法不同，这里我们直接从半解析族群模型中捕捉其完整的应变概率密度。我们将新方法应用于半解析SMBHB族群模型，独立复现了NANOGrav合作组使用15年数据对该模型进行的参数估计。我们还展示了GWB中离散SMBHB贡献在多大程度上解除族群参数空间中的简并。最后，使用源计数强度作为我们计算的中间产物，我们以原理验证方式将PTA观测映射到基于数值流体动力学模拟“Illustris”的星系合并规则得出的SMBHB模型。我们发现星系合并后千秒差距到亚秒差距SMBHB间隔的延迟时间τ的影响，得到hc范围为(1-6)×10^-16，Nc范围为(0.3-7.1)×10^-3，τ最高可达8 Gyr。
classification.one_liner: 本文提出直接从半解析族群模型捕获完整应变概率密度的方法，并应用于SMBHB模型以复现NANOGrav结果及约束合并延迟时间。
classification.relevance_reason: 用户重点关注全息引力与凝聚态类比，本论文是经典天体物理引力波背景研究，与全息无关，仅与经典引力应用相关，故相关度低。

2609.07774v1.title: Search for Long-Transient Gravitational Waves from Supernova SN2023ixf using GFH-v2 Pipeline
2609.07774v1.abstract: We present a directed search for long-transient gravitational waves from the possible newborn magnetar remnant of SN2023ixf, a nearby Type II core-collapse supernova in the M101 galaxy. The analysis uses LIGO Hanford and Livingston data from Engineering Run 15, using coincident data lying within the on-source window associated with the supernova. We target signals from a rapidly rotating, non-axisymmetric neutron star whose spin-down is dominated by gravitational-wave emission, producing a power-law decrease in frequency and a corresponding decrease in strain amplitude. The search is performed with the GFH-v2 pipeline, based on the Generalized Frequency Hough transform. No candidate survives the coincidence and follow-up analysis. We therefore set upper limits on the maximum detectable distance as a function of initial frequency and ellipticity. For the highest ellipticity interval, the 90% upper limits reach distances of about 1-2.5~Mpc across most of the analysed band. Although these limits are below the distance to M101, the search provides the first application of GFH-v2 to a nearby core-collapse supernova and characterizes its performance on real detector data.

classification.title_zh: 利用GFH-v2管道搜寻来自SN2023ixf的长暂态引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们针对SN2023ixf（M101星系中一颗附近的II型核心坍缩超新星）可能的新生磁星残骸，展示了一次定向搜寻长暂态引力波。分析使用LIGO Hanford和Livingston在工程运行15期间的数据，并利用与超新星相关的在源时间窗内的重合数据。我们目标是快速旋转、非轴对称中子星发出的信号，其自转减慢由引力波发射主导，导致频率呈幂律下降，应变幅度相应减小。搜寻使用基于广义频率Hough变换的GFH-v2管道执行。没有候选体通过重合与后续分析。因此，我们给出了作为初频和椭率函数的最大可探测距离上限。对于最高椭率区间，90%上限在分析的大多数频带中达到约1-2.5 Mpc的距离。尽管这些上限低于M101的距离，但此次搜寻提供了GFH-v2对附近核心坍缩超新星的首次应用，并表征了其在真实探测器数据上的性能。
classification.one_liner: 利用GFH-v2管道对SN2023ixf可能磁星残骸的长暂态引力波进行定向搜索，未发现候选体并设置了距离上限。
classification.relevance_reason: 该研究是经典的引力波数据搜索，与全息理论或量子引力无关，仅涉及广义相对论框架下的天体物理信号分析。

2609.08430v1.title: Near-Horizon Tidal Disruption Events
2609.08430v1.abstract: Tidal disruption events (TDEs) offer a unique dynamical probe of the spacetime geometry around supermassive black holes (SMBHs). While conventional TDEs occur around SMBHs of $M_\bullet \sim 10^6 - 10^7 M_\odot$, where stars are disrupted far from the event horizon, here we identify a special class of TDEs around rapidly spinning SMBHs with masses $M_\bullet \gtrsim 10^8 M_\odot$, where the tidal-disruption radius approaches the gravitational radius. We term these events "near-horizon TDEs" and, by calculating geodesics in Kerr spacetime, investigate how the proximity of the horizon modifies the debris evolution and subsequent fallback. We find that for stars encountering the SMBH on parabolic orbits, up to $\sim (90 \%-95 \%)$ of the stellar debris either plunges directly into the SMBH or escapes the system. Bound orbits, by contrast, retain a substantially larger fraction of the debris. Using the resulting debris distribution, we calculate the fallback rates and find that bound orbits produce intrinsically higher peak fallback rates and shorter decay timescales, by factors of $\sim 10^3$ relative to parabolic orbits. However, when the stellar orbital angular momentum is particularly low, the peak fallback rate can be substantially suppressed by debris lost to plunge orbits. This combination of rapid fallback and a mass deficit naturally explains overluminous TDEs such as ASASSN-15lh, which standard TDE models have struggled to reproduce. Our work establishes near-horizon TDEs as a new probe of strong-field gravity and a promising tool for identifying massive, rapidly spinning SMBHs.

classification.title_zh: 近视界潮汐瓦解事件
classification.abstract_zh: 潮汐瓦解事件（TDEs）为研究超大质量黑洞周围的时空几何提供了独特的动力学探针。通常的TDEs发生在大约10^6-10^7太阳质量的黑洞周围，恒星在事件视界之外很远的地方被瓦解。然而，本文识别出一类特殊的TDEs，它们围绕质量大于约10^8太阳质量且快速旋转的超大质量黑洞发生，此时潮汐瓦解半径接近引力半径。我们将这些事件称为“近视界TDEs”，并通过计算Kerr时空中的测地线，研究视界的接近如何改变碎片演化及随后的回落过程。我们发现，对于沿抛物轨道遭遇黑洞的恒星，多达约90%-95%的恒星碎片要么直接坠入黑洞，要么逃离系统。相比之下，束缚轨道能保留显著更大比例的碎片。利用所得的碎片分布，我们计算了回落率，发现束缚轨道产生本质上更高的峰值回落率和更短的衰减时标，相对于抛物轨道约高/短10^3倍。然而，当恒星轨道角动量特别低时，峰值回落率可能因碎片损失到坠入轨道而大幅降低。这种快速回落与质量亏损的结合自然解释了如ASASSN-15lh等超亮TDEs，而标准TDE模型难以重现这些事件。我们的工作确立了近视界TDEs作为强场引力的新探针，并作为识别大质量、快速旋转的超大质量黑洞的有力工具。
classification.one_liner: 本文提出围绕快速旋转大质量黑洞的近视界潮汐瓦解事件，显示束缚轨道产生高回落率并可解释超亮TDE，为强场引力提供新探针。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文明确研究经典引力/广义相对论中的强场时空与测地线，属于用户重点标签之一。

2509.01368v4.title: Photon surfaces extensions for dynamical gravitational collapse
2509.01368v4.abstract: The equations for the photon surface in spherical symmetry are worked out, starting from arXiv:gr-qc/0005050, in the most general dynamical setting. We show that the condition for a timelike hypersurface to be a photon surface can be reformulated as a non-autonomous dynamical system, whose analysis reveals that the same condition also holds when the surface is generated by a null radial geodesic. As an application, we consider a well-known model of a spherical dust cloud undergoing gravitational collapse. In the marginally bound case the photon surface condition reduces to an exact planar dynamical system, whose analysis shows that the extension of the exterior photon surface $r=3M$ into the cloud is unique, and null, if and only if the central singularity is covered, an open set of timelike extensions being available otherwise. Comparing our findings with those in arXiv:1910.13758, we then investigate analytically whether the null extension covers the singularity developing in the Lemaitre-Tolman-Bondi (LTB) model.

classification.title_zh: 动态引力坍缩中的光子面延伸
classification.abstract_zh: 我们从arXiv:gr-qc/0005050出发，在一般动态球对称背景下推导了光子面的方程。我们证明，一个类时超曲面成为光子面的条件可重构为一个非自治动力系统，其分析表明，当该曲面由类光径向测地线生成时，同一条件也成立。作为应用，我们考虑一个著名的球对称尘埃云引力坍缩模型。在边际束缚情形下，光子面条件约化为精确的平面动力系统；分析表明，外部光子面 r=3M 向云内的延伸是唯一的且为类光，当且仅当中心奇点被覆盖；否则存在一开集的类时延伸。我们将所得结果与arXiv:1910.13758中的结果比较，并解析地研究该类光延伸是否覆盖Lemaitre-Tolman-Bondi（LTB）模型中形成的奇点。
classification.one_liner: 证明球对称引力坍缩中光子面条件可化为动力系统，且尘埃云坍缩时外部 r=3M 光子面延伸的类光唯一性与中心奇点被覆盖等价。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文直接属于用户标注的“经典引力/广义相对论”方向，研究引力坍缩中光子面延伸与中心奇点覆盖的关系，但不涉及全息对应或量子引力。

2510.06220v2.title: Reducing systematic uncertainties in gravitational-wave population analyses by increasing the detection threshold
2510.06220v2.abstract: From catalogs of gravitational-wave transients, the population-level properties of their sources and the formation channels of merging compact binaries can be constrained. However, astrophysical conclusions can be biased by misspecification or misestimation of the population likelihood. Despite detection thresholds on the false-alarm rate (FAR) or signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), the current catalog is likely contaminated by noise transients. Further, computing the population likelihood becomes less accurate as the catalog grows. Current methods to address these challenges often scale poorly with the number of events and potentially become infeasible for future catalogs. Here, we evaluate a simple remedy: increasing the significance threshold for including events in population analyses. To determine the efficacy of this approach, we analyze simulated catalogs of up to 1600 gravitational-wave signals from black-hole mergers using full Bayesian parameter estimation with current detector sensitivities. We show that the growth in statistical uncertainty about the black-hole population, as we analyze fewer events but with higher SNR, depends on the source parameters of interest. When the SNR threshold is raised from 11 to 15---reducing our catalog size by two--thirds---we find that statistical uncertainties on the mass distribution only grow by a few 10% and constraints on the spin distribution are essentially unchanged; meanwhile, uncertainties on the high-redshift cosmic merger rate more than double. Simultaneously, numerical uncertainty in the estimate of the population likelihood more than halves, allowing us to ensure unbiased inference without additional computational expense. Our results demonstrate that focusing on higher-significance events is an effective way to facilitate robust astrophysical inference with growing gravitational-wave catalogs.

classification.title_zh: 通过提高探测阈值减少引力波群体分析中的系统不确定性
classification.abstract_zh: 从引力波瞬变目录中，可以约束其源的天体物理群体特性和合并致密双星的形成通道。然而，天体物理结论可能因群体似然函数的错误设定或错误估计而产生偏差。尽管对误报率（FAR）或信噪比（SNR）设置了探测阈值，当前目录仍可能被噪声瞬变污染。此外，随着目录的增长，群体似然函数的计算精度会下降。当前解决这些问题的方法通常随事件数量增多而缩放性变差，并且可能对未来目录不可行。在这里，我们评估了一个简单的补救措施：提高群体分析中包含事件的显著性阈值。为确定该方法的有效性，我们使用当前探测器灵敏度对来自黑洞合并的最多1600个引力波信号的模拟目录进行了完整贝叶斯参数估计。我们表明，当我们分析更少但SNR更高的事件时，关于黑洞群体的统计不确定性的增长取决于感兴趣的源参数。当SNR阈值从11提高到15——将目录规模减少三分之二——我们发现质量分布的统计不确定性只增长了几个百分之十，自旋分布的约束基本不变；同时，高红移宇宙合并速率的不确定性增加了一倍以上。与此同时，群体似然函数估计的数值不确定性减少了一半以上，使我们能够在没有额外计算开销的情况下确保无偏推理。我们的结果表明，关注更高显著性事件是利用不断增长的引力波目录促进稳健天体物理推断的有效方法。
classification.one_liner: 通过提高信噪比阈值来降低引力波目录群体分析中的系统误差，并以模拟数据论证其有效性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦于引力波观测数据分析中的统计学方法，不涉及全息原理或量子引力理论构造，仅属经典引力波天体物理范畴。

2601.15201v2.title: Effects of massive spin-2 fields on gravitational wave propagation
2601.15201v2.abstract: Massive spin-2 fields in addition to the standard massless graviton arise naturally in extensions of General Relativity, such as massive bigravity or models with extra dimensions. This work explores the observational signatures of these fields on the propagation of gravitational waves. Adopting a phenomenological framework consistent with such theories, we derive an analytical transfer function in the ultrarelativistic limit and establish detectability bounds. Finally, we provide forecasts for the accessible parameter space using current and future gravitational wave detectors.

classification.title_zh: 大质量自旋-2场对引力波传播的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论的标准无质量引力子之外，大质量自旋-2场自然出现于广义相对论的扩展理论中，例如大质量双引力或额外维度模型。本工作探索了这些场对引力波传播的观测特征。采用与此类理论一致的现象学框架，我们在极端相对论极限下推导了解析传递函数，并建立了可探测性界限。最后，我们利用当前和未来的引力波探测器，对可探测的参数空间给出了预测。
classification.one_liner: 研究大质量自旋-2场对引力波传播的观测效应，给出解析传递函数与可探测性预测。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文集中于经典引力下的引力波传播与大质量自旋-2场效应，与用户关注的全息超流超导、QNM等支线没有直接关联。

2602.13923v4.title: Coupled-Channel Spectral Theory for a Non-Separable Rotating Geometry: Normal Modes and Two-Boundary Response in the Rotating AdS-Teo Wormhole
2602.13923v4.abstract: We investigate scalar perturbations of a rotating asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS)Teo traversable wormhole with a controlled nonseparable angular deformation. The geometry retains a regular wormhole throat and the required AdS asymptotics, while explicit quadrupolar deformation generates angular-channel coupling in the intermediate region. A sufficient condition is derived for an ergoregion free parameter regime in which the spectral analysis is performed. Projecting the geometry derived Klein Gordon equation onto spherical harmonics yields a matrix valued Sturm Liouville system and an associated quadratic operator pencil. Throat regularity together with normalizable AdS boundary conditions leads to a determinant quantization condition for the discrete normal mode spectrum. Two, four, and six channel calculations demonstrate systematic numerical convergence of the retained low lying normal mode frequencies under enlargement of the angular basis. The complete finite generalized eigenspectrum is also examined without imposing a near reality selection criterion, and no growing scalar mode is found within the ergoregion free parameter range and numerical resolutions studied. The six channel rotation continuation exhibits a finite interior level repulsion feature accompanied by collective redistribution of the multichannel eigenvectors. The same coupled spectral framework formally defines a matrix valued two boundary response whose poles are selected by the normal-mode matching condition, the response plots presented here illustrate this structure using the reduced two channel effective model rather than a numerical reconstruction of the full six channel response.

classification.title_zh: 不可分离旋转几何的耦合道谱理论：旋转 AdS-Teo 虫洞中的正规模式与双边界响应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有受控不可分离角形变的旋转渐近反德西特（AdS）Teo 可穿越虫洞上的标量扰动。几何保持规则虫洞喉部和所需 AdS 渐近行为，显式四极形变在中间区域产生角向道耦合。推导了一个无能层参数区间的充分条件，并在该区间内进行谱分析。将几何导出的 Klein-Gordon 方程投影到球谐函数上，得到矩阵值 Sturm-Liouville 系统及相应的二次算子束。喉部正则性与可归一化 AdS 边界条件给出离散正规模谱的行列式量子化条件。二、四、六通道计算显示在增大角向基时低阶正规模频率具有系统数值收敛性。还在未施加近实选择判据的情况下考察了完整的有穷广义本征谱；在无能层参数范围和所研究的数值分辨率内未发现增长标量模。六通道转动延拓表现出有限内部能级排斥，并伴随各通道本征向量的集体重分配。同一耦合道谱框架形式地定义了矩阵值双边界响应，其极点由正规模匹配条件选取；文中响应图使用约化二通道有效模型说明该结构，而非对完整六通道响应的数值重建。
classification.one_liner: 本文用耦合道谱方法研究旋转 AdS-Teo 虫洞中的标量微扰，计算离散正规模和双边界响应，并在无能层参数范围内未发现增长标量模。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文主要研究旋转 AdS-Teo 虫洞背景上标量扰动的谱分析和线性稳定性，属于经典引力/广义相对论范畴，直接命中用户经典引力支线重点标签；摘要未涉及全息对偶或量子引力内容，故不判为理论全息。

2604.00078v4.title: Regular Black Strings and $(2+1)$ Black Hole in Unimodular Gravity Supported by Maxwell Fields
2604.00078v4.abstract: In this work, we obtain regular solutions with a dynamical cosmological function in unimodular gravity. This alternative theory to General Relativity imposes an additional condition on the spacetime volume element by fixing the metric volume density to a prescribed non-dynamical quantity, which can be represented by a constant in unimodular coordinates. In this procedure, the cosmological constant does not appear directly in the action, but rather as an integration constant of the field equations. By using the non-conservation of the energy-momentum tensor, we show that the integration constant becomes a function $\Lambda(x)=\Lambda_0+\delta\Lambda(x)$, where $\Lambda_0$ is the vacuum cosmological constant and $\delta\Lambda(r)$ is a matter-induced cosmological contribution determined by the geometry and the electromagnetic sector. From the definition of the geometric function $H(r)$, we verify the validity of Maxwell electrodynamics as a source for the solutions. We further show that linear combinations of the mass functions associated with the individual solutions can also be consistently supported by the Maxwell field, a property that is not generally shared by nonlinear electrodynamics. This result allows us to construct a broader family of regular solutions and investigate their physical properties. In particular, we analyze the energy conditions, curvature invariants, and thermodynamic properties of the generated solutions.

classification.title_zh: 正则黑洞弦与单模引力中Maxwell场支持的(2+1)维黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们在单模引力中获得具有动力学宇宙学函数的正则解。这种广义相对论的替代理论通过对时空体积元施加额外条件来修正度量体积密度为一个预设的非动力学量，该量在单模坐标中可表示为常数。在此过程中，宇宙学常数并不直接出现在作用量中，而是作为场方程的积分常数出现。通过利用能量-动量张量的非守恒，我们证明积分常数变为函数Λ(x)=Λ0+δΛ(x)，其中Λ0是真空宇宙学常数，δΛ(r)是由物质诱导的宇宙学贡献，由几何和电磁扇区决定。从几何函数H(r)的定义出发，我们验证了Maxwell电动力学作为这些解的源的有效性。我们还表明，与各个解相关的质量函数的线性组合也可以一致地被Maxwell场支持，这一性质通常不被非线性电动力学所共有。这一结果使我们能够构造更广泛的正则解族并研究其物理性质。特别地，我们分析了所生成解的能量条件、曲率不变量和热力学性质。
classification.one_liner: 单模引力中由Maxwell场支持的正则黑洞弦和(2+1)维黑洞，其宇宙学常数作为物质诱导的动力学函数出现。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及经典引力中的正则黑洞解和热力学，但未涉及全息或量子引力，与重点研究支线无直接关联。

2604.08511v2.title: Metric affine gravity with dynamical chronology protection
2604.08511v2.abstract: Modified theories of gravity often introduce geometric structure beyond general relativity to address unresolved problems in the gravitational sector without invoking ad hoc matter fields. Mimetic gravity, for example, generates an effective cosmological dark sector by isolating the conformal mode of the metric, while Horava-Lifshitz gravity attains power-counting renormalizability by endowing spacetime with a preferred dynamical foliation. Although chronology protection was not the original motivation for either theory, both can realize it classically through stable causality. This suggests that chronology protection itself may be elevated from a derived property to a guiding principle for constructing modified gravitational theories, especially if its implementation at the quantum-gravitational level leaves infrared imprints in the effective action. Motivated by this possibility, we introduce a toy metric-affine gravity model whose chronology-protecting sector is purely geometric. The model breaks projective invariance and selects a timelike, closed non-metricity one-form. In the globally exact sector, this one-form defines a time function, realizing stable causality through affine geometry. On the matter-free, spatially flat FLRW branch, the gravitational sector contains the two tensor modes of GR and a single scalar mode. We investigate the classical cosmological effects and scalar-mode dynamics of this purely geometric chronology-protecting extension of general relativity.

classification.title_zh: 具有动态时序保护的度量仿射引力
classification.abstract_zh: 修改引力理论常常引入广义相对论之外的几何结构，以在不引入特设物质场的情况下解决引力领域中的未决问题。例如，模拟引力通过分离度规的共形模产生有效的宇宙学暗扇区，而 Horava-Lifshitz 引力通过赋予时空一个优选的动力学叶状结构实现幂次可重整化。尽管时序保护并非这两种理论的原始动机，但二者都能通过稳定因果性经典地实现它。这表明时序保护本身可以提升为构建修改引力理论的指导原则，特别是在其量子引力层面的实现会在有效作用量中留下红外印记的情形下。受此可能性驱动，我们引入一个玩具度量仿射引力模型，其时序保护扇区纯粹是几何性的。该模型破坏射影不变性，并选取一个类时的闭合非度量性一形式。在全局精确扇区中，这一形式定义了一个时间函数，通过仿射几何实现稳定因果性。在无物质、空间平坦的 FLRW 分支上，引力扇区包含 GR 的两个张量模和一个标量模。我们研究了这一纯粹几何的、扩展广义相对论的时序保护方案的经典宇宙学效应及标量模动力学。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种度量仿射修改引力模型，纯几何地实现时序保护，并研究其宇宙学效应和标量模动力学。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典修改引力与宇宙学，与全息/AdS-CFT、黑洞量子引力等信息论方向无关，与用户重点全息研究支线不重合。

2604.16039v2.title: Measuring the rate of glitches in interferometric gravitational wave detectors with a hierarchical Bayesian model
2604.16039v2.abstract: Ground-based gravitational wave detectors are now routinely surveying the dark Universe, finding hundreds of collisions between compact objects. However, terrestrial non-Gaussian noise artefacts, commonly known as glitches, reduce the sensitivity to signals and can overlap signals, producing biased astrophysical inferences. We introduce a hierarchical Bayesian model to measure the glitch rate, which improves upon existing trigger-counting methods in its capacity to measure the rate down into the low signal-to-noise regime without contamination from the Gaussian noise background, provided the population is accurately modelled. The framework accommodates any glitch model, and measures the rate with respect to the model chosen: here we use the antiglitch model, so the rate inferred is that of short-duration glitches rather than of all glitches. The methodology builds on standard hierarchical inference, but includes several novel features: hierarchical inference with quantile compression (HIQC), a generic approximation for the recycled hyperlikelihood, and a time-domain rate estimated by fitting basis functions. We validate the methodology using simulated data with injected glitches and then apply it to data from the fourth LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing run, demonstrating time-resolved inferences of the glitch rate over a 24 h period. The inferred glitch rate is consistent with estimates from trigger counts, but requires no arbitrary threshold and provides a more fine-grained view of the temporal behaviour. Finally, we demonstrate how our individual-detector rate estimates can be transformed into a coincident glitch probability and utilise this to provide evidence that the retracted gravitational-wave candidate GW230630_070659 is likely a pair of coincident glitches.

classification.title_zh: 用分层贝叶斯模型测量干涉引力波探测器中的毛刺率
classification.abstract_zh: 地基引力波探测器正在常规地探测暗宇宙，发现数百次致密天体碰撞。然而，地面非高斯噪声伪迹通常被称为毛刺，会降低对信号的灵敏度，并可能与信号重叠，产生有偏差的天体物理推断。我们引入了一个分层贝叶斯模型来测量毛刺率，相对于现有的触发器计数方法，该模型能够在不被高斯噪声背景污染的情况下测量低信噪比区域的毛刺率，前提是总体模型准确。该框架适用于任何毛刺模型，并根据所选模型测量毛刺率：这里我们使用anti毛刺模型，因此推断的速率是短时毛刺的速率，而不是所有毛刺的。该方法基于标准分层推断，但包含几个新特征：带分位数压缩的分层推断(HIQC)、通用近似循环超似然、以及通过拟合基函数估计时域速率。我们用模拟数据和注入毛刺验证了该方法，然后将其应用于第四次LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA运行数据，演示了24小时内毛刺率的时间分辨推断。推断的毛刺率与触发器计数估计一致，但不需要任意阈值，并提供了时间行为的更细粒度视图。最后，我们展示了如何将单个探测器的速率估计转换为符合毛刺概率，并据此提供证据表明被撤回的引力波候选体GW230630_070659很可能是两个符合的毛刺。
classification.one_liner: 采用分层贝叶斯模型测量引力波探测器中的毛刺率，并用于分析LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA运行数据及识别候选事件为符合毛刺。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文关注引力波探测器噪声分析与统计方法，属于经典引力实验数据分析，与理论全息或量子引力无直接关联。

2605.04110v2.title: High-Power AM-CW Lunar Laser Ranging as a $\mu$Hz SGWB Detector
2605.04110v2.abstract: High-power amplitude-modulated continuous-wave lunar laser ranging (AM-CW LLR) is a stochastic-gravitational-wave-background (SGWB) experiment that measures GW-driven drift and diffusion of the Earth--Moon orbit. Its observable is the coherent phase of a GHz modulation envelope returned by an individually resolved single hollow corner-cube retroreflector (HCCR), converted to absolute range and analyzed through its time-dependent mean and covariance. The response occurs at lunar orbital harmonics; the dominant low-eccentricity channel is centered at $f_2=0.847245\,\mu{\rm Hz}$, and a five-year broadband forecast applies to spectra smooth over the resolution scale $T_{\rm obs}^{-1}=6.34\,$nHz about that resonance. A scalar 1-kW, 1064-nm link yields $5.893\times10^3$ detected photons s$^{-1}$ and an $88.8$--$124.3\,\mu$m photon contribution in 100 s, while the forecasts adopt projected total range precisions of $80$ and $50\,\mu$m. In the covariance-dominated weak-signal regime, $\Omega_{\rm gw}^{95}\propto\sigma_R^2\nuEff^{-1}T_{\rm obs}^{-4}$. Using the published Earth--Moon response normalization, the five-year 95\% thresholds are $1.86\times10^{-7}\Dtot$ for $80\,\mu$m and $500\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$ and $2.42\times10^{-8}\Dtot$ for $50\,\mu$m and $1500\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$, where $\Dtot$ is the full-analysis threshold divided by the unit-factor response-anchored forecast. If end-to-end calibration, sampling, and marginalization give $\Dtot\le1.15$, the higher-performance campaign reaches nominal source-statistic equality for $\Omega_{\rm gw}=7.08\times10^{-8}$ in five years. These measurable performance and information-retention requirements define high-power AM-CW LLR as a standalone quantitative SGWB experiment at the $0.85\,\mu{\rm Hz}$ Earth--Moon resonance.

classification.title_zh: 高功率调幅连续波月球激光测距作为 μHz 随机引力波背景探测器
classification.abstract_zh: 高功率调幅连续波月球激光测距（AM-CW LLR）是一种随机引力波背景（SGWB）实验，通过测量引力波引起的地球-月球轨道漂移和扩散来进行探测。其可观测量为由单独分辨的空心角锥后向反射器（HCCR）返回的 GHz 调制包络的相干相位，该相位可转换为绝对距离，并通过其随时间变化的均值和协方差进行分析。响应出现在月球轨道谐波频率处；主导的低偏心率通道中心位于 f2=0.847245 μHz，五年宽带预报适用于在该共振附近、频率平滑尺度超过 T_obs^-1=6.34 nHz 的谱。1 kW、1064 nm 标量链路每秒可探测到 5.893×10^3 个光子，并在 100 秒内贡献约 88.8–124.3 μm 的光子噪声；预报采用了预计总距离精度 80 μm 和 50 μm。在协方差主导的弱信号区域，Ω_gw^95 ∝ σ_R^2 ν_Eff^-1 T_obs^-4。利用已发表的地球-月球响应归一化，五年 95% 阈值在 80 μm 精度、500 yr^-1 采样时为 1.86×10^-7 D_tot，在 50 μm 精度、1500 yr^-1 采样时为 2.42×10^-8 D_tot，其中 D_tot 为全分析阈值除以单位因子响应锚定预报。若端到端标定、采样和边际化给出 D_tot ≤ 1.15，则高性能方案在五年内对 Ω_gw=7.08×10^-8 达到标称源统计相等。这些可测量的性能和信息保持要求将高功率 AM-CW LLR 定义为在 0.85 μHz 地球-月球共振处的独立定量 SGWB 实验。
classification.one_liner: 提出用高功率调幅连续波月球激光测距作为 μHz 随机引力波背景探测器，给出五年观测的灵敏度阈值与实验要求。

2605.05500v3.title: Classical tests of New General Relativity
2605.05500v3.abstract: In New General Relativity (NGR), the static spherically symmetric vacuum solution is characterized by two parameters, unlike General Relativity (GR), where the Schwarzschild solution has only one parameter. In this work, using the five classical tests of relativistic gravity (perihelion precession, light bending, Shapiro time delay and de Sitter geodetic precession effect, as well as gravitational redshift), a more stringent constraint on the value of the second parameter was derived compared to the original work [1].

classification.title_zh: 新广义相对论的经典检验
classification.abstract_zh: 在“新广义相对论”（NGR）中，静态球对称真空解由两个参数表征，而在广义相对论（GR）中，Schwarzschild 解只有一个参数。本工作利用相对论引力的五个经典检验（近日点进动、光线偏折、Shapiro 时间延迟、de Sitter 测地线进动效应以及引力红移），推导出了比原始文献 [1] 更严格的第二个参数约束。
classification.one_liner: 利用五个经典引力测试对新广义相对论中的额外参数给出更严格约束。

2605.14078v2.title: Properties of natural polynomials for Schwarzschild and Kerr black holes
2605.14078v2.abstract: The quasi-normal modes of black holes play various important roles in gravitational wave theory, signal modeling, and data analysis; however, there remain open questions about their mathematical properties. Aspects of classical polynomial theory have been proposed as a framework to investigate quasinormal mode orthogonality and completeness. We have recently presented a class of polynomials that are "natural" to quasi-normal modes in that they are restricted by the quasi-normal mode boundary conditions, and exactly tridiagonalize Teukolsky's radial equation. In turn, these polynomials may be useful for better understanding the vector space properties of quasi-normal mode solutions to that equation. Here, we provide an overview of these polynomials' analytic properties: their 3-term recurrence relation, ladder operators and governing differential equation. We demonstrate that the natural polynomials for Schwarzschild and Kerr black holes are Pollaczek-Jacobi polynomials with complex valued parameters. Along the way, we observe a novel property that is particular to Schwarzschild: the polynomials' 3-term recurrence relation always peaks at the physical overtone index. This work supports the broader application of these polynomials, as well as their extension to black hole spacetimes beyond Schwarzschild and Kerr.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild 和 Kerr 黑洞自然多项式的性质
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞的准正规模式在引力波理论、信号建模和数据分析中扮演多种重要角色，但其数学性质仍存在开放问题。人们已提出经典多项式理论的若干方面作为研究准正规模式正交性与完备性的框架。我们最近提出了一类对准正规模式“自然”的多项式，它们受准正规模式边界条件约束，并精确三对角化 Teukolsky 径向方程。这些多项式可能有助于更好地理解该方程准正规模式解的向量空间性质。本文概述这些多项式的解析性质：三项递推关系、阶梯算符和主导微分方程。我们证明 Schwarzschild 和 Kerr 黑洞的自然多项式是具有复值参数的 Pollaczek-Jacobi 多项式。同时，我们观察到 Schwarzschild 特有的一个新性质：多项式的三项递推关系总是在物理泛音指标处达到峰值。该工作支持这些多项式的更广泛应用，以及将其推广到 Schwarzschild 和 Kerr 之外的黑洞时空。
classification.one_liner: 研究 Schwarzschild 与 Kerr 黑洞准正规模式自然多项式的解析性质，证明其为复参数 Pollaczek-Jacobi 多项式。
classification.relevance_reason: 该工作研究经典 Schwarzschild/Kerr 黑洞的准正规模式数学性质，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论与 QNM 方向，与用户关注的经典引力支线高度相关。

2605.18212v2.title: Short-Range Tests of the Gravitational Inverse-Square Law
2605.18212v2.abstract: Experimental constraints on the gravitational inverse-square law at short range are presented, employing a consistent formalism across a wide range of length scales. We provide comprehensive updates incorporating new experimental data from the past decade - spanning tabletop forces, Casimir measurements, slow neutron scattering, and collider searches - building upon our previous review. This work facilitates the direct comparison of experimental results with theoretical models that extend general relativity. Furthermore, a comparison between various model parametrizations, including extra-dimensional models, is introduced. Finally, results from tabletop experiments are compared with those from high-energy collider experiments for both Yukawa and power-law potentials.

classification.title_zh: 引力平方反比定律的短程测试
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在短距离上对引力平方反比定律的实验约束，采用了一种在广泛长度尺度上一致的形式体系。我们基于先前的综述，纳入了过去十年新实验数据的全面更新——涵盖桌面力、卡西米尔测量、慢中子散射和对撞机搜寻。这项工作有助于将实验结果与扩展广义相对论的理论模型进行直接比较。此外，还引入了包括额外维模型在内的各种模型参数化之间的比较。最后，将桌面实验结果与高能对撞机实验结果在汤川势和幂律势下进行了比较。
classification.one_liner: 短程引力平方反比定律实验约束的综述更新，涵盖实验与理论模型的比较。

2605.25950v2.title: Gravitational wave interactions with matter: beyond quadrupolar perturbations
2605.25950v2.abstract: Previous work has developed the theory of linearized gravitational wave (GW) interactions with matter using the Bondi-Sachs formalism, but with the perturbations restricted to be quadrupolar, i.e., the angular dependence is spherical harmonic with $\ell=2$. Here, the theory is extended to the case of GWs on a Minkowski background with general $\ell$. Formulas for the GW damping and heating effects are obtained for arbitrary $\ell\ge 2$. It is found that the effects are, generally, enhanced, and this suggests that it is unlikely that higher $\ell$-modes will be seen in GW observations of the post-merger signal of a binary neutron star merger, or of a core collapse supernova.

classification.title_zh: 引力波与物质的相互作用：超越四极扰动
classification.abstract_zh: 先前的工作利用 Bondi-Sachs 形式发展了线性化引力波与物质相互作用的理论，但扰动被限制为四极的，即角依赖是 ℓ=2 的球谐函数。本文将理论推广到闵可夫斯基背景上一般 ℓ 的引力波情形。对任意 ℓ≥2 得到了引力波阻尼与加热效应的公式。研究发现这些效应通常会增强，这表明在双中子星并合后信号或核坍缩超新星的引力波观测中不太可能看到更高的 ℓ 阶模。

2607.11851v3.title: Corrected thermodynamics and radiation predictions of modified black bounce compact objects
2607.11851v3.abstract: We study the thermodynamic properties and radiation characteristics of a regular compact object obtained by applying the Simpson-Visser (SV) regularisation to the Schwarzschild modified gravity black hole. The resulting SV-MOG spacetime, whose lapse function involves both the MOG coupling parameter alpha and the black-bounce parameter l, smoothly interpolates between a regular black hole, a one-way wormhole, and a traversable wormhole depending on the parameter l. We derive the Hawking temperature and heat capacity for the black hole branch, identifying second-order phase transitions signaled by sign changes in CV, and, for the horizonless wormhole branch where no causal horizon and hence no genuine Hawking radiation exists we instead construct a physically well-defined effective temperature from the Lyapunov exponent of the unstable photon sphere. Quantum gravitational corrections to the entropy are incorporated via logarithmic terms parameterized by coefficients beta1, beta2, whose theoretically preferred ranges in loop quantum gravity and string theory we discuss, and we show that deviations from the Bekenstein-Hawking area law become significant at small horizon radii. A linear scalar-perturbation analysis further shows that the effective radial potential remains non-negative throughout the black-hole exterior and across the wormhole throat, indicating stability against monopole perturbations independently of the thermodynamic stability inferred from the heat capacity.

classification.title_zh: 修正的黑反弹致密物体的热力学与辐射预测
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了通过Simpson-Visser（SV）正则化应用于Schwarzschild改进引力（MOG）黑洞所获得的规则致密物体的热力学性质和辐射特性。所得SV-MOG时空的时移函数同时包含MOG耦合参数α和黑反弹参数l，随l的取值在规则黑洞、单向虫洞和可穿越虫洞之间光滑过渡。我们推导了黑洞分支的霍金温度和热容，识别出由热容变号表示的二阶相变；对于没有因果视界、因此不存在真正霍金辐射的无视界虫洞分支，我们改用不稳定光子球的Lyapunov指数构造了物理上定义良好的有效温度。量子引力修正通过由参数β1、β2参数化的对数项纳入熵中，我们讨论了它们在圈量子引力和弦理论中理论偏好的取值范围，并表明在小视界半径处对Bekenstein-Hawking面积律的偏离变得显著。线性标量扰动分析进一步表明，有效径向势在黑洞外部和虫洞喉部始终非负，表明对单极扰动的稳定性与热容所推断的热力学稳定性无关。
classification.one_liner: 对SV-MOG黑反弹致密物体的黑洞/虫洞分支统一给出热力学、有效温度、量子熵修正与稳定性分析。

2607.20687v3.title: A First-Order Gauge Approach to de Sitter General Relativity
2607.20687v3.abstract: We propose a first-order gauge formulation of de Sitter relativity in which the pseudo-radius l(x) is promoted to a spacetime field, locally breaking SO(4,1) to SO(3,1). Here, l(x) is a geometric compensator and dl(x) the associated order parameter. This modifies the Strong Equivalence Principle: the local vacuum follows the matter distribution instead of remaining fixed, while the propagating degrees of freedom of General Relativity are unchanged. At fixed l(x), the action is SO(3,1)-gauge invariant, but varying l(x) destroys covariance under the full translational sector of SO(4,1). Through the Inonu-Wigner contraction, abstract generators become explicit spacetime transformations, yielding nonlinear Killing vectors in both the macroscopic l tends to infinity and microscopic l tends to 0 limits. The generalized Noether theorem gives a unified energy-momentum current coupling the standard tensor to the proper conformal matter current. It vanishes identically without matter, causing the asymptotic extinction of local vacuum energy and the decay of the background to Minkowski spacetime. Independent variations yield the coupled de Sitter field equations, and we algebraically prove their equivalence to the tensorial splitting on the coordinate manifold. Gauge Bianchi identities further show that Lambda(x) is an intrinsic source of spacetime torsion, consistently identifying it with the local order parameter of the symmetry breaking. The cosmological constant problem is therefore recast, not numerically solved: deriving the decay of Lambda(x) from early-universe densities to its observed value remains future work.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter广义相对论的一阶规范方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种 de Sitter 相对论的一阶规范表述，其中伪半径 l(x) 被提升为时空场，局域地将 SO(4,1) 破缺为 SO(3,1)。这里 l(x) 是几何补偿场，dl(x) 是相应的序参量。这修改了强等效原理：局域真空随物质分布而变化，而非保持固定，但广义相对论的传播自由度不变。在固定 l(x) 时，作用量具有 SO(3,1) 规范不变性，但变化 l(x) 会破坏 SO(4,1) 完整平移部分的协变性。通过 Inonu-Wigner 收缩，抽象生成元成为显式时空变换，在宏观 l 趋于无穷和微观 l 趋于 0 的极限下给出非线性 Killing 矢量。广义 Noether 定理给出一个统一能量-动量流，将标准张量与正则共形物质流耦合。该流在无物质时恒为零，导致局域真空能量渐近消失并使背景衰变到 Minkowski 时空。独立变分得到耦合的 de Sitter 场方程，我们代数地证明了它们与坐标流形上的张量分裂等价。规范 Bianchi 恒等式进一步表明 Lambda(x) 是时空挠率的内禀来源，从而将其一致地识别为对称性破缺的局域序参量。因此宇宙常数问题被重新表述，而不是数值求解：从早期宇宙密度推导 Lambda(x) 衰减到其观测值仍是未来工作。
classification.one_liner: 通过把 de Sitter 伪半径提升为补偿场并破缺 SO(4,1) 到 SO(3,1)，构造了经典引力的一阶规范理论，并将宇宙常数重新解释为挠率的局域序参量。

2608.19392v3.title: Gravitational-wave propagation and standard sirens in dynamical Barbero--Immirzi gravity: an action-level analysis
2608.19392v3.abstract: We develop an action-level framework for identifying which dynamical Barbero--Immirzi sectors can modify cosmological tensor propagation in a bosonic, two-derivative, curvature-linear Einstein--Cartan class. Eliminating the algebraic Lorentz connection shows that the Holst-to-Palatini ratio contributes to the scalar kinetic metric, whereas the transverse-traceless tensor normalization is controlled by the parity-even Hilbert--Palatini coefficient. Consequently, a dynamical Holst coefficient at fixed parity-even normalization does not by itself generate anomalous gravitational-wave friction: the minimal dynamical-Holst theory lies exactly on the general-relativistic propagation surface. We then construct a leading analytic parity-invariant nonminimal realization, exhibit a regular cosmological background satisfying both Friedmann equations, and verify the invariant two-derivative kinetic conditions along that benchmark. Finally, we recast published GWTC-3 and GWTC-4.0 constraints and the two public GWTC-4.0 hyperposterior products to determine which action-level combination present standard sirens constrain. The corresponding catalog constraints remain broad and depend on the adopted priors and population assumptions; itconstrains the evolution of a nonminimal parity-even curvature sector rather than minimal Barbero--Immirzi torsion, providing an action-level interpretation of standard-siren propagation tests.

classification.title_zh: 动力学 Barbero--Immirzi 引力中的引力波传播与标准汽笛：作用量级分析
classification.abstract_zh: 我们发展了一个作用量级框架，用于识别哪些动力学 Barbero--Immirzi 扇区能够在玻色型、双导数、曲率线性的 Einstein--Cartan 类中修正宇宙学张量传播。消去代数 Lorentz 联络表明，Holst 与 Palatini 之比贡献于标量动能度规，而横迹无迹张量归一化由宇称偶的 Hilbert--Palatini 系数控制。因此，在宇称偶归一化固定的情况下，动力学 Holst 系数本身不会产生异常的引力波摩擦：最小动力学 Holst 理论精确落在广义相对论传播面上。然后我们构造了一个领先的解析宇称不变非最小实现，展示了满足两个 Friedmann 方程的正则宇宙学背景，并验证了沿该基准的规范双导数动能条件。最后，我们重新表述已发表的 GWTC-3 和 GWTC-4.0 约束以及两个公开的 GWTC-4.0 超后验产物，以确定标准汽笛约束的是哪种作用量级组合。相应的目录约束仍然宽泛，并依赖于所采用的先验和总体假设；它约束的是非最小宇称偶曲率扇区的演化，而非最小 Barbero--Immirzi 挠率，从而为标准汽笛传播测试提供了作用量级的解释。
classification.one_liner: 从作用量层面分析动力学 Barbero--Immirzi 引力对引力波传播的影响，并表明标准汽笛约束的是非最小宇称偶曲率扇区而非最小挠率。

2609.03935v2.title: On the interplay between waveform systematics and lensing signatures in gravitational-wave signals
2609.03935v2.abstract: The exceptional gravitational-wave event GW231123 exhibited unusually high total mass and near-extremal spins, while revealing strong waveform-dependent variations in its inferred source properties. Several follow-up studies favored a lensed interpretation, with reduced waveform systematics, raising the question of whether apparent lensing evidence could arise from waveform modeling systematics. Using GW231123-like numerical-relativity injections, we find that lensing degrees of freedom can reduce waveform discrepancies and yield non-negligible lensing support. However, this behavior is not systematic across injections, and cases where all waveform and lens models favor lensing while reducing waveform discrepancies are not found.

classification.title_zh: 引力波信号中波形系统效应与透镜特征之间的相互作用
classification.abstract_zh: 卓越的引力波事件GW231123表现出异常高的总质量和接近极端的自旋，同时其推断源性质在不同波形模型下显示出强烈差异。几项后续研究倾向于透镜解释，并声称波形系统效应减小，这引发了一个问题：明显的透镜证据是否可能源于波形建模的系统效应。使用类似GW231123的数值相对论注入，我们发现透镜自由度可以减少波形差异并产生不可忽略的透镜支持。然而，这种行为并非在所有注入中系统性地出现，也未发现所有波形和透镜模型都青睐透镜且同时减少波形差异的案例。
classification.one_liner: 该研究用数值相对论注入检验GW231123的透镜证据是否可能是波形建模系统效应所致，发现并非系统性。

2609.05375v2.title: Fast Bayesian Inference for Long-Duration Gravitational-Wave Signals in 3G detectors
2609.05375v2.abstract: Third-generation (3G) gravitational-wave detectors will observe binary-neutron-star inspirals for nearly a day, so Earth's rotation becomes part of the signal rather than a negligible correction. This destroys the usual separation between intrinsic and extrinsic parameters and creates a major computational bottleneck for Bayesian inference. We show that the exact five-harmonic Jaranowski-Krolak-Schutz (JKS) decomposition restores the separation of the rotating antenna amplitude response from the computationally expensive intrinsic waveform calculations. By sampling the intrinsic waveform on a frequency grid set by its phase curvature and then applying error-controlled relative binning, likelihood evaluations for a 21.3-h signal are accelerated by O(10^4), making day-long 3G signal inference practical.

classification.title_zh: 第三代探测器长持续时间引力波信号的快速贝叶斯推断
classification.abstract_zh: 第三代（3G）引力波探测器将观测近一天的双中子星旋近过程，因此地球自转成为信号的一部分而非可忽略的修正。这破坏了通常的内禀参数与外禀参数分离，并给贝叶斯推断造成重大计算瓶颈。我们证明精确的五谐波Jaranowski-Krolak-Schutz（JKS）分解能够将旋转天线幅度响应与计算成本高的内禀波形计算分离开来。通过在其相位曲率设定的频率网格上对内禀波形采样，再应用误差受控的相对分箱，21.3小时信号的对数似然评估被加速约10^4倍，使日长3G信号推断变得可行。
classification.one_liner: 利用JKS分解与相对分箱，将3G探测器长达一天引力波信号的贝叶斯推断加速四个数量级。

2410.04258v2.title: Comparison of HMG and flat rotation velocities inferred from galaxy-galaxy weak lensing
2410.04258v2.abstract: Despite the success of dark-matter models, unresolved issues require exploring alternatives such as modified gravity theories. In this context, we examine the compatibility of the Hyperconical Modified Gravity (HMG) with galaxy rotation curves inferred from weak-lensing data. The research addresses the existing limitations of Modified Newtonian Dynamics (MOND), which often struggle with universal applicability across different galactic scales. By assuming local validity of General Relativity (GR) and analyzing recent data on circular velocities from galaxy-galaxy weak lensing, our findings interpret the galactic dynamics anomaly as a fictitious acceleration inherited from the cosmic expansion, without invoking dark matter. The results indicate that HMG successfully reproduces flat velocity curves on scales of 1 Mpc slightly better than MOND. Therefore, these observations support HMG as a viable gravitational model, highlighting its potential to account for dynamics on galaxies and other scales. Further research with extensive datasets is required to confirm these preliminary insights.

classification.title_zh: HMG与星系-星系弱透镜推断的平坦旋转速度的比较
classification.abstract_zh: 尽管暗物质模型取得了成功，但尚未解决的问题促使人们探索诸如修正引力理论等替代方案。在此背景下，我们检验了超圆锥修正引力（HMG）与从弱透镜数据推断的星系旋转曲线的兼容性。研究解决了修正牛顿动力学（MOND）在跨不同星系尺度普遍适用性方面的现存局限。通过假设广义相对论（GR）的局部有效性，并分析来自星系-星系弱透镜的近期圆周速度数据，我们的发现将星系动力学异常解释为从宇宙膨胀继承而来的虚拟加速度，而无需引入暗物质。结果表明，HMG在1 Mpc尺度上比MOND略好地重现了平坦速度曲线。因此，这些观测支持HMG作为可行的引力模型，凸显了其解释星系及其它尺度动力学的潜力。需要更广泛数据集的进一步研究来证实这些初步见解。
classification.one_liner: HMG修正引力模型无需暗物质即可在1 Mpc尺度上比MOND稍好地重现星系平坦旋转速度。

2601.13912v2.title: Frequency shift and viewing direction variations in gravitational lensing
2601.13912v2.abstract: In a gravitational lensing system, the relative transverse velocities of the lens, source, and observer induce a frequency shift in the observed radiation. While this shift is typically negligible in most astrophysical contexts, strategies for its detection have been proposed for both electromagnetic and gravitational waves. This paper provides a rigorous theoretical treatment of the effect, deriving general expressions for the frequency shift within a lensing system embedded in a cosmological spacetime. Our formulation remains valid for arbitrary distances and velocities, including highly relativistic regimes, under any Friedmann-Lema\^{i}tre-Robertson-Walker metric. Expanding upon previous papers on moving lenses, we provide a detailed analysis of frequency effects induced by lenses moving at relativistic speeds. Furthermore, we extend standard lensing theory by deriving an exact formula for the variation in the source's viewing direction. This result is of interest for strongly anisotropic emitters, such as compact binary systems emitting gravitational waves. Finally, we quantify the apparent misalignment between the lens and the source's two images produced by time-delay effects in lens systems moving with high velocity.

classification.title_zh: 引力透镜中的频移与观测方向变化
classification.abstract_zh: 在引力透镜系统中，透镜、源和观测者之间的相对横向速度会导致观测到的辐射发生频移。尽管在大多数天体物理情形中这种频移通常可以忽略，但已有针对电磁波和引力波的探测策略提出。本文对该效应进行了严格的理论处理，推导了嵌入宇宙学时空的透镜系统中频移的一般表达式。该公式在任意距离和速度下均有效，包括高度相对论性区域，适用于任意 Friedmann-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker 度规。在先前关于运动透镜工作的基础上，我们详细分析了相对论速度运动的透镜引起的频率效应。此外，我们通过推导源的观测方向变化的一个精确公式，扩展了标准透镜理论。这一结果对强各向异性辐射体（如发射引力波的致密双星系统）具有重要意义。最后，我们量化了高速度运动透镜系统中时间延迟效应引起的透镜与源的两个像之间的视在错位。
classification.one_liner: 严格推导了宇宙学时空中运动透镜系统的频移和视角变化公式，并分析了高速度下的时间延迟错位。

2603.10120v2.title: On the angular localization of gravitational-wave signals by pulsar timing arrays
2603.10120v2.abstract: We provide a complete study of gravitational-wave signal localization using pulsar timing arrays. We derive analytical expressions for the Cram\'er-Rao sky localization precision that delineate the impact of the angular proximity, $\xi$, between the pulsar and the gravitational wave source, and the precision, $\sigma_L$, with which pulsar distances are known. Interference between the Earth and pulsar terms creates rapid angular oscillations for sky-coordinate Fisher matrix elements that aid localization, which is complemented by more broadly varying antenna response gradient information. The relative importance of these factors depends on whether pulsar distances are known precisely [i.e., $\sigma_L\leq\lambda_\mathrm{GW}/(1-\cos\xi)$] or imprecisely. If pulsar distances are known precisely, tightening this distance precision improves signal localization according to $\Delta\Omega_\mathrm{sky}\propto(\sigma_L/L)^2$ until the Earth-pulsar system reaches its diffraction limit, $\Delta\Omega_\mathrm{sky}\propto(\lambda_\mathrm{GW}/L)^2$. If pulsar distances are not known well, localization precision is degraded, but more pulsars in close proximity to the source is the best means of improving. With $\alpha$ indexing pulsars, this scales as $\Delta\Omega_\mathrm{sky}~\propto~(\sum_\alpha \mathrm{SNR}_\alpha^2/\xi_\alpha^2)^{-1}$ in the small-angle limit of the unmarginalized Fisher matrix, and we derive the analytic generalization to any angle between a pulsar and the source. Finally, we study a scenario where pulsar-term phases are treated as nuisance variables that are unconnected to binary or PTA properties. This phase-decoupled scenario, which is how all PTA continuous wave searches are currently conducted, delivers localization performance similar to the antenna-response--driven case, and does not exhibit significant improvement as pulsar distance precisions are tightened.

classification.title_zh: 关于脉冲星计时阵列对引力波信号的角向定位
classification.abstract_zh: 我们给出了利用脉冲星计时阵列进行引力波信号定位的完整研究。我们推导了Cramér-Rao天区定位精度的解析表达式，刻画了脉冲星与引力波源的角距离$\xi$以及脉冲星距离测量精度$\sigma_L$的影响。地球项与脉冲星项之间的干涉效应在天球坐标Fisher矩阵元中产生有助于定位的快速角振荡，并由变化更平缓的天线响应梯度信息加以补充。这些因素的相对重要性取决于脉冲星距离是精确已知（即$\sigma_L\leq\lambda_{\mathrm{GW}}/(1-\cos\xi)$）还是不精确。若脉冲星距离精确已知，则提高距离精度会使信号定位按$\Delta\Omega_\mathrm{sky}\propto(\sigma_L/L)^2$改善，直到地球-脉冲星系统达到衍射极限$\Delta\Omega_\mathrm{sky}\propto(\lambda_{\mathrm{GW}}/L)^2$。若脉冲星距离未知得不好，定位精度会降低，但靠近源的更多脉冲星是最佳改进手段。以$\alpha$标记脉冲星时，在小角度极限下对未边缘化Fisher矩阵有$\Delta\Omega_\mathrm{sky}\propto(\sum_\alpha \mathrm{SNR}_\alpha^2/\xi_\alpha^2)^{-1}$，我们还推导了该结果向任意脉冲星-源夹角的解析推广。最后，我们研究了将脉冲星项相位视为与双星或PTA性质无关的冗余参数的场景。这种相位解耦情形——目前所有PTA连续波搜索都如此进行——给出的定位性能与天线响应驱动情形相近，并且随着脉冲星距离精度提高没有显著改进。
classification.one_liner: 通过解析Fisher矩阵系统研究了脉冲星计时阵列对引力波源的角向定位精度，揭示了脉冲星距离精度、脉冲星-源夹角以及地球-脉冲星干涉效应对定位的影响。
